column43: Aalberts NV engages in the development of industrial products and systems. The company is headquartered in Langbroek, Utrecht and currently employs 13,124 full-time employees.  The company is engaged in integrated piping systems and hydronic flow control systems for buildings, advanced mechatronics for semiconductor OEMs and surface technologies for various industries. The company is divided into segments building technology and industrial technology. The firm designs, develops and manufactures integrated piping systems to distribute and regulate water or gas flows in heating, cooling, water, gas and sprinkler systems in residential, commercial and industrial buildings. The company also co-develops, engineers and manufactures tailor-made integrated qualified modules and solutions enabling the technology roadmaps of worldwide active (SPE) semiconductor production equipment OEMs. The firm offers advanced heat and surface treatments to improve material characteristics. With a global network of service locations, Aalberts offers tailor-made processes to customers in general industries, automotive, aerospace, and semiconductor.

column43: AB Agri is a leading international agri-food business based in the UK, specializing in farm performance services, animal feed, specialty ingredients, and supplements. The company actively engages with partners to promote responsible farming practices and address environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors, ensuring that its operations contribute positively to the communities and ecosystems in which it operates. By leveraging local knowledge and expertise, AB Agri aims to deliver tailored solutions that meet the evolving needs of its stakeholders. AB Agri's vision includes fostering a more sustainable agricultural ecosystem through continuous improvement in health, safety, and environmental standards. The company invests in research and development to drive advancements in agricultural technology and practices, positioning itself as a trusted partner in the agricultural community. With a workforce of over 3,000 employees, AB Agri fosters a culture of diversity, inclusion, and continuous development, striving to create a workplace where every colleague can thrive. Through its initiatives, AB Agri aims to empower its clients and partners to navigate the challenges of climate change while enhancing food security and nutrition globally.

column43: Abbott Laboratories engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of health care products. The company is headquartered in Abbott Park, Illinois and currently employs 114,000 full-time employees.  The firm is engaged in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of a broad and diversified line of health care products. The firm operates through four segments: Established Pharmaceutical Products, Diagnostic Products, Nutritional Products, and Medical Devices. The Established Pharmaceutical Products segment is engaged in the international sales of a broad line of branded generic pharmaceutical products. The Diagnostic Products segment is engaged in the worldwide sales of diagnostic systems and tests for blood banks, hospitals, commercial laboratories, and alternate-care testing sites. The Nutritional Products segment is involved in the worldwide sales of a broad line of adult and pediatric nutritional products. The Medical Devices segment includes the worldwide sales of rhythm management, electrophysiology, heart failure, vascular, structural heart, neuromodulation, and diabetes care products.

column43: Gestamp is a multinational specialized in the design, development and manufacture of highly engineered metal components for the main vehicle manufacturers. It develops products with an innovative design to produce lighter and safer vehicles, which offer lower energy consumption and a lower environmental impact. Its products cover the areas of BiW, chassis and mechanisms.  Gestamp is present in 24 countries with 115 production plants, 13 R&D centers and a workforce of more than 44,000 employees worldwide. The Company works with the largest world manufacturers in order to look for solutions focused on reducing car weight. Moreover, Gestamp also works on safety in case of collision in all its product range: body, chassis and mechanisms. For this reason, the 16 main world automotive groups trust Gestamp for equipping more than 800 vehicles with components manufactured by the Spanish company. Gestamp offers the whole value chain, from the press and dies (molds that shape the pieces) creation and manufacture to the final product manufacturing which will be assembled on the vehicles. The autoparts manufacturer promotes the training and development of its 42,000 employees, as they are the growth engine of the company, which has presence in 24 countries and counts with 115 production plants and 13 R&D centres. The firm considers that training and innovation are two fundamental pillars within Gestamp.

column43: Aer Lingus, founded in 1936, is Ireland's national airline, providing scheduled passenger and cargo services to over 100 destinations across Europe, the UK, and North America from its hubs in Dublin, Cork, Shannon, and Knock. As a member of the International Airlines Group (IAG), Aer Lingus is dedicated to delivering exceptional travel experiences while prioritizing sustainability and environmental responsibility. The airline's mission is to connect people and cultures, aiming to be the leading airline for transatlantic travel from Ireland. Aer Lingus has set ambitious sustainability goals, including achieving net zero carbon emissions by 2050 and powering 10% of its flights with sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) by 2030. Recognized as a 4-star airline by Skytrax, Aer Lingus focuses on providing a high-quality travel experience characterized by exceptional service and comfort. Its diverse clientele includes leisure travelers, business professionals, families, and sports teams, making it a preferred choice for those flying to and from Ireland. The airline actively partners with various organizations, such as the Irish Rugby Football Union (IRFU) and Pure Leapfrog, to enhance its service offerings and promote community engagement. Aer Lingus also participates in initiatives like the Single European Sky, which aims to improve air traffic management efficiency and reduce aviation emissions across Europe. In addition to its commitment to sustainability, Aer Lingus engages in community initiatives, exemplified by its "Make a Difference Day," where employees volunteer to support local schools and charities. The airline's target market includes both domestic and international travelers seeking quality service and competitive pricing, reflecting its mission to connect Ireland to the world while contributing positively to the communities it serves.

The brand caters to a discerning clientele that includes fashion-forward individuals and high-profile celebrities who appreciate high fashion and artistic expression. Through collaborations with various artists and designers, the brand enriches its narrative and cultural relevance in the fashion industry. column43: Align JV is a prominent joint venture formed by three leading infrastructure companies: Bouygues Travaux Publics, Sir Robert McAlpine, and VolkerFitzpatrick. The company specializes in delivering significant infrastructure projects, particularly the High Speed 2 (HS2) railway initiative in the UK, which is Europe's largest infrastructure project. Currently, Align JV is focused on constructing the Central 1 package, which includes the record-breaking Colne Valley Viaduct, set to be the longest railway bridge in the UK, and a 10-mile twin-bored tunnel under the Chiltern Hills.  Align JV operates as an Integrated Project Team (IPT), emphasizing collaboration, safety, and innovative engineering solutions to achieve the highest standards in construction and project delivery. The company's mission is to act as a catalyst for growth across Britain, aligning with HS2's vision to enhance connectivity and economic development while minimizing environmental impact. This commitment is reflected in their efforts to reduce carbon emissions, create wildlife habitats, and promote ecological preservation through advanced construction methods. The company serves a diverse range of clients, including government bodies and local communities, and collaborates closely with various stakeholders, including local authorities and educational institutions. Align JV prioritizes community engagement and aims to provide substantial employment opportunities, including apprenticeships and training programs, to support local talent development. By focusing on sustainability and community benefits, Align JV seeks to leave a lasting legacy of biodiversity and economic growth in the regions it serves. Through its innovative approaches and commitment to environmental stewardship, Align JV is dedicated to shaping the future of rail transport in the UK while ensuring minimal disruption and maximum benefit to the surrounding communities.

column43: Allegro MicroSystems, Inc. engages in the development and manufacture of sensor integrated circuits (â€œICsâ€) and application-specific analog power ICs. The company is headquartered in Manchester, New Hampshire and currently employs 4,593 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2020-10-29. The company is a supplier of magnetic sensor IC solutions in the automotive market. Its sensor ICs enable its customers to precisely measure motion, speed, position and current, while its power ICs include high-temperature and high-voltage capable motor drivers, power management ICs, light-emitting diode driver ICs and isolated gate drivers. Its diverse product portfolio provides solutions for the electrification of vehicles, automotive advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) safety features, automation for Industry 4.0 and power saving technologies for data centers and clean energy applications. Through its subsidiary, Crocus Technology, Inc. offers tunnel magnetoresistance (TMR) solutions that provide magnetic sensitivity, lower power consumption, and the smallest size in comparison to other magnetic technologies.

column43: Ancala is an independent infrastructure manager founded in 2010, specializing in investing in and enhancing traditional asset-backed infrastructure companies across essential sectors and geographies. column43: The Angola LNG Project is one of the largest ever single investments in the oil and gas industry in Angola. Its plant is located in Soyo, 350km north of Luanda, at the mouth of the Congo River. It has been designed to process up to 1.1 billion cubic feet of gas per day with nominal capacity of 5.2 million tons of LNG per year, as well as producing propane, butane and condensate and up to 125 million cubic feet of gas per day for supply to the local market. Angola LNG gathers, processes and creates value from associated gas produced in oil operations. By utilising associated gas in this way, it significantly contributes to the elimination of gas flaring in Angola while allowing for the development of offshore oil reserves in an environmentally sustainable manner. It creates value from an important resource that would otherwise be wasted. The project is the result of a partnership between Sonangol, Chevron, BP, Eni and TotalEnergies.

column43: Toyota Motor Manufacturing UK (TMUK) is a prominent automotive manufacturer based in the United Kingdom, specializing in the production of motor vehicles and engines, particularly the Corolla model and its hybrid variants. The company operates two key manufacturing plants: one in Burnaston, Derbyshire, where vehicles are assembled, and another in Deeside, North Wales, dedicated to engine production. TMUK is deeply committed to sustainability and aims to achieve carbon neutrality across its operations, aligning with Toyota's global vision of "Mobility for All." The company's mission emphasizes the importance of sustainable manufacturing practices, innovation, and delivering exceptional value while minimizing environmental impact. TMUK actively engages with local communities through its Charitable Trust, supporting various causes such as health and social inclusion, and has raised significant funds for charities like Children with Cancer UK. The company prioritizes the development of its workforce through comprehensive training programs, including apprenticeships, to foster a skilled and diverse workforce. TMUK's clients primarily include Toyota Motor Europe, which markets and sells the vehicles produced, while its partnerships extend to local suppliers and community organizations, reflecting its dedication to corporate social responsibility. The target market encompasses not only the UK but also various European countries, with some exports reaching South America, Asia, and Africa. Through its strategic initiatives, TMUK seeks to adapt to market demands and technological advancements, ensuring long-term growth and sustainability in the automotive sector. With a strong emphasis on continuous improvement and environmental responsibility, Toyota Motor Manufacturing UK strives to maintain its reputation as a leader in the automotive industry while contributing positively to society and fostering long-term relationships with stakeholders.

column43: Venator Materials Plc is a leading global producer of titanium dioxide (TiO2) and specialty chemical products, headquartered in Wynyard, U.K. The company operates through two primary segments: Titanium Dioxide, which focuses on the production of TiO2, and Performance Additives, which includes high-value functional additives and color pigments. Venator serves a diverse range of industries, including coatings, plastics, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, construction, and agriculture, with a client base that includes over 1,800 industrial customers across more than 109 countries.  Venator's mission is to enhance the quality of life through innovative products that improve performance and sustainability, while its vision emphasizes operational excellence and environmental responsibility. The company is committed to reducing its environmental footprint and actively works towards sustainability initiatives, such as the Payload Efficiency Project, which aims to minimize transportation emissions and costs. Venator also focuses on energy efficiency and transformation, with goals to significantly reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions by 2030. With a workforce of approximately 2,700 associates, Venator fosters a culture of safety, integrity, and teamwork, ensuring high-quality products and services tailored to meet the evolving needs of its customers. The company collaborates with various stakeholders, including suppliers and partners, to enhance product stewardship and drive continuous improvement in quality and sustainability. Despite facing cyclical challenges in the market, Venator is positioned for long-term growth, driven by its commitment to innovation and efficiency in operations, ultimately aiming to create a positive impact on both its customers and the communities it serves.

column43: Avnet, Inc. engages in the provision of distribution and sale of electronic components. The company is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona and currently employs 15,462 full-time employees. ZF's vision emphasizes sustainability and the commitment to achieving climate neutrality by 2040, reflecting its dedication to responsible business practices and environmental stewardship. The company actively engages in initiatives that promote a circular economy and resource efficiency, ensuring that its operations align with global sustainability goals. ZF invests heavily in research and development, allocating â‚¬3.6 billion in 2024 to advance technologies that support the future of mobility. The company's extensive product portfolio includes driveline and chassis technology, as well as active and passive safety systems, positioning ZF as a leader in the automotive supply industry. ZF collaborates with various partners across sectors to drive innovation and enhance its technological capabilities, ensuring that it meets the evolving demands of the market. Through its commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability, ZF Group strives to shape the future of transportation, creating a safer, more efficient, and environmentally friendly mobility ecosystem.

column43: B&M Retail is one of the UK's fastest-growing variety retailers, operating over 750 stores across the country and expanding its footprint in France. The company places a strong emphasis on exceptional customer service and maintaining high store standards, which contributes to a positive shopping experience. B&M's vision includes a commitment to internal development, with over 80% of management positions filled by home-grown talent, reflecting its dedication to fostering career progression and employee growth. The retailer is also committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace, offering flexible part-time roles and extensive training opportunities for its employees. B&M partners with trusted suppliers, including well-known brands like Procter & Gamble, to enhance its product offerings and ensure a reliable supply of fast-moving consumer goods. Additionally, the company engages in community initiatives, partnering with charities such as Mind to support mental health initiatives and promote social well-being. By prioritizing ethical business practices and the fair treatment of workers throughout its supply chain, B&M Retail not only serves a broad target market but also demonstrates its commitment to community engagement and responsible retailing.

column43: Beckhoff Automation is one of the world's leading specialists for automation and PC-based control technology. We are an owner-managed family business that employs over 5,000 people around the world, and we generated sales of 1.182 billion euros in 2021. Our headquarters are located in Verl, East Westphalia. Thanks to an additional 24 branches in Germany, 40 international subsidiaries and global cooperation partners in over 75 countries, we are always within close range of our customers so that we can provide support on-site at any time. Our passion for innovation Beckhoff is a high-tech company. Our employees develop and produce our innovative products and solutions entirely in-house, using a strong foundation of PC-based control technology. Bundling all of our skill sets within our own company is a crucial factor in our success. Our product range spans the main areas of industrial PCs, I/O and fieldbus components, drive technology, automation software, control cabinet-free automation, and hardware for machine vision. Our customers use this diversity to successfully implement pioneering concepts for controlling and automating their applications. Our mission is to develop products and automate production processes in such a way that they consume less resources and less energy than in the past. Every year, effectiveness and productivity must be increased to meet the global desire for more prosperity in an ecologically sustainable way. As we say at Beckhoff, 'Engineers must save the world!'

column43: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. is a global biotechnology company headquartered in San Rafael, California, that specializes in developing innovative medicines for patients with serious and life-threatening genetic conditions. Founded in 1997, BioMarin is dedicated to translating genetic discoveries into transformative therapies, focusing on addressing significant unmet medical needs. The company's mission is to improve the lives of patients and their families by leveraging its expertise in genetics and molecular biology to create effective treatments. BioMarin's robust portfolio includes eight marketed products that target various rare inherited and lysosomal storage diseases, including severe hemophilia A and achondroplasia, with VOXZOGO being a notable treatment for the latter. The company prides itself on fostering a people-first culture that encourages collaboration and empowers its talented workforce to drive progress in the biotechnology sector. BioMarin actively partners with healthcare professionals, patient advocacy groups, and regulatory agencies to ensure that its therapies are accessible and effective for those in need. Its target market primarily consists of individuals affected by rare genetic conditions, and the company is committed to expanding its reach in both established and emerging markets. With a diverse pipeline of commercial, clinical, and preclinical candidates, BioMarin aims to be a leader in the biotechnology industry by delivering first-in-class and best-in-class therapeutics that significantly enhance patient outcomes. Through bold scientific research and collaboration, BioMarin continues to strive for innovation and operational excellence, ultimately seeking to make a profound impact on the lives of patients worldwide.

column43: Bio-Techne Corp. is a global life sciences company providing innovative tools and bioactive reagents for the research and clinical diagnostic communities. The company is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota and currently employs 3,100 full-time employees.  The firm's products assist scientific investigations into biological processes and the nature and progress of specific diseases. The Company, in partnership with Wilson Wolf, is creating products such as media and cytokines that are specifically tailored to G-Rex Bioreactors. Its segments include Protein Sciences and Diagnostics and Genomics. The Protein Sciences segment is a developer and manufacturer of biological reagents used in all aspects of life science research, diagnostics and cell and gene therapy. Through our core values of sustainability, quality and leadership, we operate responsibly with respect to the health, safety and wellbeing of our employees, contractors and the communities in which we operate.  For us, steel is the fabric of life, as it is at the heart of the modern world from railways to cars and washing machines. We are actively researching and producing steel-based technologies and solutions that make many of the products and components we use in our everyday lives more energy-efficient. With a geographically diversified portfolio of iron ore and coal assets, we are strategically positioned to serve our network of steel plants and the external global market.   In 2022, ArcelorMittal had revenues of $79.8 billion and crude steel production of 59.0 million metric tonnes, while iron ore production reached 45.3 million metric tonnes.

column43: BOC UK & Ireland is the leading provider of industrial, medical, and special gases in the region, with over 135 years of experience in delivering high-quality products and tailored supply solutions. The company serves a diverse clientele, including healthcare providers, manufacturing industries, and the energy sector, with a commitment to enhancing productivity and safety. BOC's mission emphasizes safety, reliability, and environmental performance, while its vision focuses on supporting the transition to a net-zero future through innovative gas solutions. The extensive product range includes atmospheric gases, high-purity gases, and specialized mixtures, catering to applications from medical oxygen therapy to industrial welding. As a subsidiary of Linde plc, BOC leverages global resources and expertise to provide cutting-edge solutions that drive efficiency and safety in the workplace. The company is dedicated to maintaining high ethical standards and social responsibilities, aiming for climate neutrality by 2050. BOC collaborates with national occupational health providers to deliver specialized advice and monitor long-term health issues, ensuring a safe work environment for its clients.  With a robust distribution network and expert technical support, BOC prides itself on exceptional customer service and satisfaction. The company is committed to sustainability, as evidenced by its ISO 14001 certification, and actively engages with suppliers to ensure compliance with its Supplier Code of Conduct. BOC UK & Ireland continues to pioneer advancements in medical gas technology, optimizing patient care through innovative solutions and best-in-class services. Its focus on quality and reliability positions BOC as a trusted partner for over 400,000 customers across various industries, driving continuous improvement in operational efficiency and environmental performance.

The company collaborates with various influencers and fashion icons to boost its visibility and appeal, ensuring it remains relevant in the fast-paced fashion industry. Boohoo's commitment to customer satisfaction is evident in its user-friendly online shopping experience, which includes easy returns and multiple payment options. Through its innovative marketing strategies and strong online presence, Boohoo continues to expand its global footprint, serving a diverse clientele across various countries, including the UK, USA, and Australia. The brand's focus on fast fashion allows it to quickly respond to emerging trends and customer preferences, reinforcing its position as a leading player in the competitive online retail market.

The Trust is dedicated to enhancing the well-being of individuals and communities across the UK, with a particular focus on health, lifelong learning, community development, and social care. The Trust prioritizes initiatives that promote diversity, equality, and inclusion, reflecting its commitment to caring for healthier communities. It is particularly focused on alleviating hygiene poverty and enhancing the quality of life for individuals facing challenges in accessing basic health resources. To achieve its goals, the Trust collaborates with various organizations, including The Hygiene Bank and Fareshare, to distribute essential items to NHS frontline workers and those in need. Boots Charitable Trust has donated over Â£10 million to date, supporting registered charities and small voluntary organizations that benefit local communities. Its partnerships with key organizations such as Macmillan Cancer Support and The Prince's Trust address critical social issues, including youth unemployment and health disparities. By fostering strong community ties and supporting local initiatives, Boots Charitable Trust plays a vital role in building healthier and more sustainable communities. The Trust's initiatives reflect a commitment to corporate social responsibility and community engagement, aligning with Boots UK's broader vision of promoting health and well-being for all.

column42: Boston Scientific Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of medical devices that are used in interventional medical procedures. Its Endoscopy business develops and manufactures devices to diagnose and treat a broad range of gastrointestinal (GI) and pulmonary conditions with less invasive technologies. Its Urology business develops and manufactures devices to treat various urological conditions for both male and female anatomies. Its Neuromodulation business develops and manufactures devices to treat various neurological movement disorders and manage chronic pain. Its Cardiovascular segment includes Cardiology and Peripheral Interventions. Its Interventional Cardiology Therapies business develops and manufactures technologies for diagnosing and treating coronary artery disease and aortic valve conditions. The company also owns the transcarotid artery revascularization (TCAR) platform.

column42: About Autoliv Autoliv, Inc. is the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems, and through our subsidiaries we develop, manufacture and market protective systems, such as airbags, seatbelts, steering wheels and pedestrian protection systems for all major automotive manufacturers in the world. Our products save over 30,000 lives each year and prevent ten times as many severe injuries.  Our close to 67,000 employees in 27 countries are passionate about our vision of Saving More Lives and quality is at the heart of everything we do. We have 14 technical centers, with 19 test tracks.   In the world of automotive occupant safety, we were the first to introduce the two- and three-point seat belt system and airbags for front and side impacts. We were also the first to launch pyrotechnic belt pretensioners and pedestrian protection systems.    Autoliv, Inc. is a publicly traded Delaware U.S.  corporation with its headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. Sales in 2018 amounted to US $ 8,678 million. The shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ALV) and the Swedish Depository Receipts on Nasdaq Stockholm (ALIV sdb). For more information go to  www.autoliv.com.

Wire identification includes handheld printers, wire markers, sleeves and tags. Healthcare identification includes wristbands, labels, printing systems, and other products used in hospital, laboratory, and other healthcare settings for tracking and improving the safety of patients. People identification includes name tags, badges, lanyards, rigid card printing systems, and access control software.

column42: Bruker Corp. engages in the business of developing, manufacturing, and distributing high-performance scientific instruments and analytical and diagnostic solutions that enable customers to explore life and materials at microscopic, molecular, and cellular levels. The company is headquartered in Billerica, Massachusetts and currently employs 11,396 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2000-08-04. Its BSI BioSpin segment designs, manufactures, and distributes enabling life science tools based on magnetic resonance technology. Its BSI CALID segment designs, manufactures and distributes life science mass spectrometry and ion mobility spectrometry solutions, analytical and process analysis instruments and solutions. Its BSI Nano segment designs, manufactures and distributes advanced X-ray instruments, atomic force microscopy instrumentation, advanced fluorescence optical microscopy instruments. Its Bruker Energy & Supercon Technologies (BEST) segment develops and manufactures superconducting and non-superconducting materials and devices for use in renewable energy, energy infrastructure, healthcare and big science research. Its product lines include nCounter, CosMx, GeoMx and AtoMx. The company also owns electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) business.

column42: Buckfast Abbey is a historic Benedictine monastery located in the scenic Dartmoor National Park in Devon, England. With a legacy spanning over a thousand years, the Abbey is dedicated to the spiritual growth and community life of its monks and nuns, following the ancient Rule of St. Benedict. The Abbey emphasizes a balanced life of prayer, work, and study, creating a supportive environment for both personal and communal development. Its mission is to live out the Gospel through daily liturgical practices while radiating its spirituality to visitors and the wider community. Buckfast Abbey welcomes guests for spiritual retreats, educational programs, and various community events, aiming to engage individuals seeking a deeper connection with their faith. The Abbey serves as a place of reflection, learning, and spiritual renewal for people of all backgrounds, attracting a diverse clientele that includes tourists, local families, and educational groups. It partners with local schools to enhance musical education, featuring a professional choir for children and offering exhibitions and musical performances. In addition to its spiritual and educational endeavors, Buckfast Abbey is known for its beekeeping initiatives and the production of its famous Buckfast Tonic Wine. These activities not only connect the monastery to its local community but also promote sustainable practices. Through its outreach and hospitality, Buckfast Abbey stands as a unique destination that combines spiritual nourishment with recreational experiences, fostering a sense of community and connection among all who visit.

column41: Auria Solutions is a leading global supplier specializing in highly engineered systems for automotive acoustics, flooring, and cargo management, catering to both gas and electric vehicles. With its operational headquarters in Southfield, Michigan, the company operates 16 manufacturing facilities and 10 technical centers across 10 countries, employing approximately 3,900 team members. Auria's mission is to create innovative sensory experiences for the future of mobility, focusing on lightweight, durable, and environmentally friendly solutions that enhance vehicle comfort and performance. The company is dedicated to upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance, with a strong emphasis on sustainability and responsible sourcing throughout its supply chain. Auria's commitment to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles is reflected in its rigorous compliance programs, including initiatives for conflict minerals and adherence to REACH regulations. The company serves a diverse clientele, including major automotive manufacturers such as General Motors, Mercedes Benz, and BMW, and targets both original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and aftermarket consumers. column43: CCL Design is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of innovative printed, decorative, and functional products, catering to a diverse clientele in the automotive, consumer electronics, and industrial sectors. The company is committed to transforming ambitious ideas into tangible realities, utilizing its expertise in design, prototyping, and large-scale manufacturing to tackle complex challenges faced by its clients. CCL Design's mission is to provide high-quality, reliable product identification solutions while continuously innovating to meet the evolving needs of the market.  With a strong emphasis on sustainability and community engagement, CCL Design actively participates in initiatives such as Habitat for Humanity's projects, reflecting its dedication to social responsibility. The company has established state-of-the-art facilities worldwide, including a recent R&D center for Imprint Energy in California, which underscores its commitment to advancing technology and innovation. CCL Design collaborates with leading global brands, ensuring that its products enhance both functionality and aesthetics across various applications, from backlit displays to intelligent labels. As a division of CCL Industries, CCL Design operates 205 production facilities across 43 countries and employs approximately 25,300 people. The company focuses on delivering exceptional value to its multinational clients through innovative design and efficient production processes. By leveraging advanced technologies and materials science, CCL Design creates a diverse range of products, including labels, packaging solutions, and precision components. The company's dedication to continuous improvement and sustainability aims to reduce its environmental impact while consistently delivering high-quality solutions to its customers.

(abbreviated as CPP), founded in 1973, is a professional company of China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) specializing in pipeline engineering and construction. CPP holds the philosophy of "Unlimited Innovation and Contribution" and pursues the core values of "Challenge, Fine Management, Innovation, Teamwork, Harmony". CPP is dedicated to be China's No. 1 and a world-class international general contractor for pipeline construction, providing service and guarantee the oil & gas strategy channel for China and as an integrated international energy company for the goal of CNPC, while creating wealth and value for owners, employees and society.  CPP develops its way of growing by implementing the integration of pipeline and tank construction, integration of construction and service, integration of domestic and international markets, and integration of offshore and onshore projects. CPP covers the whole industry chain and pipeline core technology such as pipeline R&D, survey, consulting, design, procurement, construction, coating, fitting fabrication, intelligent pigging, maintenance and repair, telecommunication, and commissioning. CPP is capable to provide packaged solution and one-stop service to customers. CPP has been certified under various certificates such as special grade qualification for Petrochemical and Petroleum Project General Contracting, grade A certificate for Engineering and Design, grade A certificate for Pipeline Survey, Consult, Design and Supervision, and grade A certificate for Telecommunication General Contracting. CPP is also certified by quality and HSE management systems. CPP is capable to carry out EPC and PMC projects. CPP has developed standard-structured spreads complete with professional equipment for pipeline construction, tank installation, HDD and tunneling.  CPP has constructed more than 40 long-distance pipelines, more than 50,000 km, installed tanks of 20,000,000 cubic meters.

column43: Cimpress Plc invests in and builds entrepreneurial and mass-customization businesses. The company is headquartered in Dundalk, Louth and currently employs 15,000 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2019-12-05. Its segments include Vista, PrintBrothers, The Print Group, National Pen and All Other Businesses. The Vista segment includes Vista, the parent brand of multiple offerings, including VistaPrint, VistaCreate, 99designs by Vista, Vista Corporate Solutions, and Depositphotos. The PrintBrothers segment includes its druck.at, Printdeal, and WIRmachenDRUCK businesses. The Print Group segment includes its Easyflyer, Exaprint, Pixartprinting, and Tradeprint businesses. The National Pen segment includes the global operations of its National Pen business, which manufactures and markets custom writing instruments and promotional products, apparel and gifts. The All Other Businesses segment includes two businesses grouped together based on materiality. Its products are marketing materials, business cards, signage, packaging and others.

column43: Foseco, a division of Vesuvius plc, is a global leader in providing innovative products and solutions for the foundry industry, established in 1932. The company specializes in enhancing foundry performance through advanced technologies and consumables, offering a comprehensive range of products including exothermic feeding systems, filters, coatings, and refractory materials tailored for iron, steel, and nonferrous foundries. Foseco's mission is to partner with foundry customers to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and promote sustainability, while its vision emphasizes continuous research and development to meet the evolving challenges of the industry.  Foseco serves a diverse clientele, including major sectors such as automotive, aerospace, and general manufacturing, collaborating closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions that address specific needs and challenges. The company is committed to sustainability, aiming to help foundries minimize their environmental impact while maximizing productivity and quality. Foseco's innovative solutions include systems for metal stream inoculation, environmentally friendly binders, and energy-saving crucibles, all designed to enhance the quality and efficiency of metal casting processes. With a strong focus on research and development, Foseco leads the market in environmentally friendly and economically viable foundry solutions. Their recent innovations, such as the award-winning SEMCO range of water-based coatings, exemplify their commitment to eco-friendly practices and customer-centric innovation. Foseco prides itself on its technical expertise and dedication to customer service, ensuring that expert advice and support are always accessible to its clients. Through participation in industry events like GIFA, Foseco showcases its dedication to driving the foundry industry towards a more sustainable future, ultimately creating a better tomorrow for both the planet and its customers.

column43: Coats is a world leader in thread manufacturing and structural components for apparel and footwear, as well as an innovative pioneer in performance materials. These critical solutions are used to create a wide range of products, including ones that provide safety and protection for people, data, and the environment. Headquartered in the UK, Coats is a FTSE250 company and a FTSE4Good Index constituent. Revenues in 2022 were $1.6bn. Trusted by the world's leading companies to deliver vital, innovative, and sustainable solutions, Coats provides value-adding products including apparel, accessory and footwear threads, structural components for footwear and accessories, fabrics, yarns, and software applications. Customer partners include companies from the apparel, footwear, automotive, telecoms, personal protection, and outdoor goods industries. With a proud heritage dating back more than 250 years and spirit of evolution to constantly stay ahead of changing market needs, Coats has operations across some 50 countries with a workforce of over 17,000, serving its customers worldwide. Coats connects talent, textiles, and technology, to make a better and more sustainable world. Worldwide, there are three dedicated Coats Innovation Hubs, where experts collaborate with partners to create the materials and products of tomorrow. It participates in the UN Global Compact and is committed to Science Based sustainability targets for 2030 and beyond, with a goal of achieving net-zero by 2050. Coats is also committed to achieving its goals in Diversity, Equity & Inclusion, workplace health & safety, employee & community wellbeing, and supplier social performance.

column43: COOK is a pioneering frozen food company established in 1997, renowned for crafting remarkable, handmade meals that deliver a homemade quality. With a strong commitment to using high-quality, sustainable ingredients, COOK prepares its food in dedicated kitchens located in Kent and Somerset, ensuring that every dish not only tastes exceptional but also looks appealing. The company operates over 90 shops across the UK and boasts a rapidly growing online presence, making its gourmet meal solutions accessible to a diverse range of customers. COOK's mission is to provide delicious, convenient meal options that alleviate the stress of mealtimes for families and individuals, while its vision emphasizes inclusivity and collaboration among its diverse team. As one of the UK's first certified B Corporations, COOK is dedicated to creating a positive social and environmental impact. The company shares 5% of its annual profits with its staff, reflecting its commitment to fostering a supportive workplace culture. COOK's core values, known as Essential Ingredients, highlight collaboration, care, and community, ensuring that every team member feels valued and included. The target market for COOK includes families and individuals seeking gourmet meal options that cater to various dietary preferences, including vegetarian, low-calorie, and family-sized meals. In addition to its focus on quality food, COOK actively engages with local communities through various initiatives, including profit sharing and community discounts. By fostering a welcoming environment, COOK aims to create a sense of belonging for all its customers while delivering exceptional food offerings that bring people together.

column46: Coveris is a leading European packaging company that manufactures paper and plastic based flexible packaging solutions for some of the world's most respected brands. Through a broad level of technical expertise, their high-quality packaging extends the shelf life of products hence helping to reduce waste and resource wastage. Together with customers Coveris is constantly working on new attractive and sustainable packaging solutions. With its corporate office in Vienna, Coveris operates 29 sites in the EMEA region with a total of 4,100 employees.

column46: Crown is a worldwide leader in the design, manufacture, and sale of packaging products and equipment for consumer and industrial products. column43: Koppers Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of treated wood products, wood treatment chemicals and carbon compounds. The company is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and currently employs 2,082 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2006-02-01. The firm operates through three segments: Railroad and Utility Products and Services (RUPS), Performance Chemicals (PC) and Carbon Materials and Chemicals (CMC). Its RUPS segment sells treated and untreated wood products, rail joint bars and services primarily to the railroad markets in the United States and Canada and treated wood products and services to the utility markets. Its PC segment develops, manufactures, and markets wood preservation chemicals and wood treatment technologies and services to a diverse range of end markets including infrastructure, residential and commercial construction, and agriculture. The firm's CMC segment is primarily a manufacturer of creosote, carbon pitch, naphthalene, phthalic anhydride, and carbon black feedstock. The firm has manufacturing capabilities in North America, South America, Australasia, and Europe.

These new boots were sold to workmen.  But fate intervened. Dr. Martens may have been made for industry but, as it turns out, they were destined for the stage. column43: Dr. Oetker is a family-owned food company headquartered in Bielefeld, Germany, with a legacy that dates back to 1891. Renowned for its diverse product range, the company specializes in baking ingredients, frozen pizzas, desserts, and snacks, catering to both individual consumers and professional bakers. With over 40 national companies operating worldwide, Dr. Oetker adapts its offerings to meet local consumer preferences while maintaining a commitment to quality and innovation. The company's mission, "Create a Taste of Home," reflects its dedication to enhancing culinary experiences and providing enjoyable moments through food. Dr. Oetker serves a broad market, including clients across Europe and North America, with products available in countries such as the Netherlands, Norway, and Canada. The company collaborates with various partners in the food industry to enhance its product offerings and sustainability initiatives. A key focus for Dr. Oetker is reducing food waste and promoting responsible consumption, which aligns with its vision of continuous improvement in production processes and sustainability practices. In addition to its commitment to quality, Dr. Oetker is dedicated to addressing health concerns, with goals to reduce sugar content in its desserts and cakes by 15% and 10%, respectively, by 2025. The company also emphasizes the importance of animal welfare and environmental practices, ensuring that its chicken meat meets the European Broiler Initiative standards. Dr. Oetker fosters a culture of diversity and inclusion within its workforce, ensuring that all employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to the company's success. Through its innovative approach and commitment to sustainability, Dr. Oetker continues to evolve to meet changing consumer preferences while making a positive impact on both consumers and the environment.

column43: Duke Manufacturing Co. designs and manufactures more than 4,500 foodservice equipment products for a wide-range of clients located across the U.S. and around the world. We design and build our products at state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in St. Louis and Sedalia, Missouri, incorporating Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing and 5S programs, that along with our ISO 9001:2000 certification, help ensure that the highest levels of quality are reflected in our products and services.    In addition, we serve markets worldwide through 6 global sales offices and distribution centers, as well as maintain a factory-authorized service network consisting of 200 locations that support the US, Canada and 85 International service/support centers.

column43: Our Group was created with the aim of strengthening its presence on the international market and promoting innovation for an increasingly sustainable growth. Specialized in the development of automated and integrated intralogistics solutions for manufacturers and distributors of consumer goods operating in the beverage, food, tissue and other sectors, in 1992 the company anticipated the concept of Industry 4.0: the Smart Factory, sustainable, interconnected and safe. Our main systems include a wide range of laser guided vehicles, palletizing robots, robotic stretch wrappers, pallet inspection systems, robotic labelers, high-density automated warehouses, storage and picking solutions. The entire logistics flow is centrally supervised by the SM.I.LE80 software platform (Smart Integrated Logistics), that ensures the efficient integration of the systems, guaranteeing the optimal management of all operations, from the entry of raw materials to storage and shipping. As of today, we completed more than 450 integrated factories in various parts of the world and installed over 2.800 robotic systems, 9.000 automatic laser guided vehicles and, since 2016, 50 automated high-density warehouses.  Our Group, based in Viano, Italy, is present in Australia, Brazil, Chile, the United Arab Emirates, France, Japan, Mexico, Spain, Sweden, the United Kingdom, Poland, Russia, Thailand and the USA with the aim of being close to its customers. To this end, it offers 24/7 remote and on-site consulting and after-sales services ensuring businesses the highest levels of digitalization, reliability and reduced margin of error. Our Group fundamental assets are the result of the expertise gained in more than 40 years of history and the sharing of hardware and software competences: enhancement of people, investments in R&D, in addition to a deep technological knowledge and an important adaptability to market needs.

column43: Mercedes AMG High Performance Powertrains, located in Brixworth, Northamptonshire, is a premier engineering company renowned for its expertise in the design, manufacture, and testing of Formula 1 power units. With a dedicated workforce of over 1,000 professionals, the company has played a pivotal role in the success of the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula One Team, contributing to numerous Constructors' and Drivers' Championships. Originally founded in 1984 as Ilmor Engineering, the company has undergone several transformations and is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Daimler AG since 2005.  Mercedes AMG HPP is committed to pioneering spirit, technical excellence, and sustainability, with a mission to win every competition it enters while fostering an inclusive and high-performance culture. The company not only focuses on motorsport but also leverages its Formula 1 expertise to develop high-performance automotive projects, including the Mercedes-AMG ONE hypercar and the Mercedes-Benz Vision EQXX. Its clientele extends beyond the Mercedes-AMG F1 team to include customer teams such as Aston Martin, Williams, and McLaren, showcasing its strong presence in the competitive motorsport landscape. In addition to its engineering prowess, Mercedes AMG HPP is dedicated to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion within the engineering sector. The company actively addresses the underrepresentation of women in motorsport and engineering through initiatives like the Accelerating Women in Engineering Programme. Furthermore, HPP nurtures talent through its Early Careers Programme, providing aspiring engineers with valuable opportunities to grow and excel. With a vision to innovate and excel in advanced technologies, Mercedes AMG High Performance Powertrains strives to create a supportive environment that empowers all employees while delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions.

column43: EBARA Precision Machinery Europe (EPME) GmbH, located in Sauerlach near Munich, operates as the European sales and service division of EBARA Corporation Tokyo, a renowned global leader in vacuum and semiconductor systems. EPME employs a diverse workforce of over 240 individuals from 28 different nationalities, reflecting its commitment to inclusivity and global collaboration. The company has forged strong partnerships with leading manufacturers in the chip industry, serving 16 of the top 20 companies worldwide. EPME is certified under ISO 45001, ISO 9001, and ISO 14001, underscoring its dedication to quality, safety, and environmental management. As a leading provider of advanced vacuum and planarization technologies, EPME focuses on delivering innovative waste recycling solutions and environmental technologies, including dry vacuum pumps and exhaust abatement systems. Its clientele spans major players in the semiconductor, solar panel, chemical, and pharmaceutical sectors, while its robust global support system positions it as a preferred supplier for both manufacturing and R&D applications. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and adhering to ESG-focused management principles, EBARA Precision Machinery Europe aims to accelerate industry advancements and enhance environmental sustainability across its target markets.

column43: Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE: EW), is the global leader in patient-focused medical innovations for structural heart disease, as well as critical care and surgical monitoring. We thrive on discovery and expanding the boundaries of medical technology, serving patients in 100+ countries, with the help of our employees in areas including Clinical Affairs, Quality Engineering, Research & Development, Regulatory Affairs, Sales & Marketing, corporate functions and more. Our roots date back to 1958 when Miles Lowell Edwards, a retired engineer with a background in hydraulics and fuel pump operations, set out to build the first artificial heart. Edwards believed the heart could be mechanized and was encouraged by Dr. Albert Starr to focus on developing an artificial heart valve. After just two years, the first Starr-Edwards mitral valve was developed and successfully placed in a patient. This innovation spawned Edwards Laboratories. Milesâ€™ fascination with healing the heart and helping patients with heart disease stemmed from his own experience with rheumatic fever as a teenager and continues to fuel our patient-first culture today. Today, we are as passionate about providing innovative solutions for people fighting cardiovascular disease as we have ever been. It's our Credo. It takes integrity, collaboration, innovation, and focus. We are leaders in the design and manufacture of tissue replacement heart valves and repair products as well as advanced hemodynamic monitoring. We partner with physicians to innovate products designed to help patients live longer, healthier, and more productive lives. Our work is both rewarding and a privilege. The importance of what we do defines our approach. We work together to create an environment where ideas can flourish and we provide our people with the resources, expertise and support to bring those ideas to life. The company's commitment to innovation is reflected in its continuous improvement efforts and investment in research and development, ensuring that it meets the evolving needs of its diverse clientele. The company is committed to achieving climate neutrality by 2045 and actively engages in initiatives to reduce CO2 emissions and enhance energy efficiency. By prioritizing resource efficiency and waste reduction, RENOLIT aims to set industry standards while contributing positively to the global climate agenda and aligning its goals with the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals.

column42: Samvardhana Motherson Reflectec (SMR) produces and distributes rear view mirror systems for the automotive industry in all vehicle and price segments and is a pioneer in intelligent camera technologies for automotive applications. The company is committed to enhancing safety and quality standards across the sector by offering comprehensive testing services that comply with British, European, and American standards. FIRA's mission is to support manufacturers, retailers, and other stakeholders in ensuring their products meet regulatory requirements, thereby protecting consumers and enhancing brand reputation. The company's clientele encompasses a diverse range of businesses from both domestic and non-domestic markets, including manufacturers, importers, and retailers. FIRA collaborates with various stakeholders, including trade associations and industry members, to ensure that the furniture sector meets and exceeds its sustainability goals. Through its comprehensive approach, FIRA International aims to foster a more sustainable future for the furniture industry while assisting its members in navigating the complexities of environmental regulations and standards. By promoting sustainability and innovation within the furniture supply chain, FIRA reflects its commitment to advancing industry standards and practices.

column42: Flight Centre Travel Group South Africa is a prominent travel agency that specializes in offering a comprehensive range of travel services, including flights, holiday packages, tours, cruises, and business travel solutions. The company is dedicated to making travel accessible and enjoyable for its clients, which include individual travelers, families, and corporate groups. With a mission to inspire and facilitate unforgettable travel experiences, Flight Centre aims to connect people with the world while ensuring exceptional service and value.  The agency is particularly focused on empowering female travelers by providing tailored travel experiences that cater to diverse interests, such as adventure, culture, wellness, and culinary delights. This commitment to celebrating the unique passions of women is a key aspect of their service offering. Flight Centre collaborates with various partners, including airlines, hotels, and tour operators, to deliver competitive pricing and exclusive deals, ensuring that clients receive exceptional value for their travel investments. Targeting a broad market, Flight Centre caters to both leisure and business travelers, making it a go-to choice for those seeking personalized travel services. The company prides itself on delivering expert advice and creating memorable travel experiences that resonate with clients' desires. With a strong presence in South Africa, Flight Centre Travel Group South Africa is committed to helping travelers explore both local and international destinations while prioritizing their safety and satisfaction. Through its extensive knowledge and resources, the agency strives to inspire and facilitate unforgettable journeys for all its clients.

column42: ForFarmers NV engages in the production and supply of animal feed and grain products. The company is headquartered in Lochem, Gelderland and currently employs 2,550 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2016-05-24. Its product portfolio comprises, among others, products for crop farming and pasture farming, as well as feed for the ruminant, swine, poultry and equine sectors, including compound feed and blends, feed for young animals and specialties, raw materials and co-products to seed and fertilizers. Its core activities are feed production, logistics and the provision of total feed solutions. The firm operates through the segments The Netherlands, Germany/Belgium and the United Kingdom, and operates approximately 40 production facilities in these countries.

column42: Foyle Food Group is a family-owned company headquartered in Omagh, Northern Ireland, and is recognized as the largest dedicated beef processor in the UK and Ireland. Foyle Food Group specializes in the full farm-to-fork process, ensuring the highest quality and safety of its beef products. The company is committed to sustainability, actively engaging with local communities and supporting over 6,000 farmers in its supply chain while promoting ethical trading practices and animal welfare. Foyle Food Group's mission emphasizes integrity, quality, and innovation, with a focus on exceeding industry standards in food safety and sustainability. The company aims for zero waste to landfill and significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030, showcasing its dedication to minimizing environmental impact through responsible sourcing and innovative practices. Foyle Food Group serves a diverse global customer base, including retailers and food service providers across the UK, Ireland, Europe, and beyond, emphasizing transparency and collaboration to meet the evolving needs of its clients. The company is recognized for its rigorous quality control measures, which enhance food safety and minimize waste. Foyle Food Group's vision includes continuous improvement in sustainability and operational efficiency, fostering community engagement, and promoting environmental stewardship. By maintaining long-term relationships with its farmers and suppliers, Foyle Food Group ensures ethical sourcing and responsible practices throughout its supply chain, reinforcing its commitment to delivering high-quality beef products while supporting local communities.

column43: Gousto is a London-based recipe box company dedicated to simplifying meal planning and cooking for its customers by delivering fresh, pre-measured ingredients and diverse recipes directly to their doorsteps. With a mission to alleviate the mealtime mental load, Gousto offers over 75 diverse recipes each week, catering to various dietary preferences and culinary tastes. The company is committed to sustainability, sourcing high-quality ingredients from trusted suppliers, and aims for 100% recyclable packaging by 2025. Gousto's target market includes busy families and individuals seeking convenient, healthy meal solutions without the hassle of grocery shopping. As a certified B Corp, Gousto emphasizes its positive impact on the environment and community, publishing an annual Impact Report to showcase its efforts. Gousto aims to inspire healthier eating habits while addressing the growing concern over ultraprocessed foods, with only 11% of the ingredients used in their recipes falling into this category. By delivering precisely the right amount of ingredients needed for each meal, Gousto effectively reduces food waste and promotes a balanced diet. The company partners with local suppliers to ensure high-quality, fresh produce, reinforcing its commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction. Gousto strives to make nutritious home cooking accessible and enjoyable for everyone, making it a popular choice among health-conscious consumers in the UK. Through its innovative approach to meal preparation, Gousto is transforming the way people think about cooking and mealtime, fostering a more sustainable food system while making the cooking experience delightful.

column43: Halfords Group Plc engages in the retail of automotive and cycling products, as well as auto repair. The company is headquartered in Redditch, Worcestershire and currently employs 12,554 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2004-06-03. The firm operates through two segments: Retail and Car Servicing. The operations of the Retail segment comprise the retailing of automotive, leisure and cycling products and services through retail stores and online platforms. The operations of the Car Servicing segment comprise car servicing and repair performed from garages and vans. The firm has an approximately 385 Halfords Retail and two Performance Cycling stores offering a wide range of motoring and cycling products and on demand services. The company has an approximately 639 garages offering MOT, service, maintenance and repair services. The company has approximately 273 direct to consumer vans, 495 Commercial vans and nine Cycling vans. The firm's product categories include motoring products, mainstream cycling products and performance cycling products. Its services include retail motoring, retail cycling and auto centers/mobile expert.

Heathrow's target market encompasses both leisure and business travelers, with a strong emphasis on improving passenger experience and operational efficiency. column43: Aurubis - Metals for Progress  Aurubis AG is a leading global provider of non-ferrous metals and one of the largest copper recyclers worldwide. Aurubis has about 7,100 employees, production sites in Europe and the US, and an extensive worldwide distribution system. Aurubis shares are part of the Prime Standard Segment of the German Stock Exchange and are listed in the MDAX, the Global Challenges Index (GCX), and the STOXX Europe 600. Today, Hendrickson is a major supplier to every North American heavy-duty truck and trailer OEM, as well as many manufacturers in Europe, Australia, Mexico, Japan, and Latin America. column43: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is a global leader in enterprise technology, dedicated to providing a comprehensive range of solutions that empower businesses to innovate and thrive in an increasingly digital landscape. The company specializes in advanced computing, storage, networking, and security solutions, alongside cloud services through its HPE GreenLake platform, which offers a flexible, consumption-based model. HPE's mission is to help customers unlock the potential of their data and drive business outcomes through technology, while its vision emphasizes a commitment to sustainability and social responsibility.  HPE serves a diverse clientele that includes large enterprises, small and medium-sized businesses, and public sector organizations, reflecting its adaptability to meet the unique needs of various sectors. The company partners with numerous technology providers to enhance its offerings, ensuring that clients receive comprehensive solutions tailored to their specific requirements. HPE's target market spans multiple industries, including healthcare, finance, education, and manufacturing, where reliable and secure technology infrastructure is essential for success. In addition to its focus on innovation and digital transformation, HPE is committed to sustainability, aiming to be a net-zero company by 2040. This commitment is evident in its initiatives that promote responsible business practices and environmental stewardship. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and hybrid cloud solutions, HPE empowers organizations to capture, analyze, and act upon data seamlessly, driving operational performance and fostering a more intelligent and connected world. Through its comprehensive suite of products and services, HPE continues to lead the charge in transforming how businesses operate in the digital age.

column43: We help our customers around the world to create attractive, efficient and more sustainable in-store environments that strengthen the consumer's shopping experience.  Present in more than 70 countries, we provide retailers and brands with merchandising and store communication solutions that grow sales, inspire shoppers, drive automation and reduce waste.  It all started in 1954 when the travelling salesman Harry Lundvall saw a problem. Products were badly displayed and there were no prices in stores. This was during the time when groceries were evolving into self-service. So, Harry took matters into his own hands. Armed with an iron and sheer enthusiasm, he started manufacturing label holders and merchandising stands in his basement. His products soon created exposure and order in stores.  Today our solutions are installed in 330 000 stores. Our near global reach and world class manufacturing capabilities enable us to deliver on both very local needs as well as large scale roll-outs. We lead the development in innovative and sustainable solutions, creating a better shopping experience for people all over the world.

The company serves a diverse clientele, ranging from small workshops and medium-sized carpentry businesses to large industrial manufacturers and construction firms, providing tailored solutions that meet specific production requirements. The company operates globally, with a presence in over 100 countries and a workforce of more than 6,500 employees, positioning itself as a key player in emerging markets such as China and India. Through its extensive service offerings, including training, remote diagnostics, and software solutions, HOMAG aims to improve operational efficiency and productivity for its clients. The company's vision encompasses a sustainable future for the woodworking industry, as it continuously invests in innovation and capacity optimization to navigate market challenges and maintain its leadership position.

column43: Bilstein Group, headquartered in Ennepetal, Germany, is a prominent global specialist in the automotive aftermarket, dedicated to providing high-quality replacement parts for passenger cars, light commercial vehicles, and trucks. Established in 1844, the company has a rich history that has evolved from trading metal products to becoming a leader in the production of over 75,000 components under its well-known brands: febi, SWAG, and Blue Print. The company's mission is to deliver OEM-matching quality parts that ensure the mobility and safety of vehicles, while its vision emphasizes innovation and responsiveness to the changing needs of the automotive industry. Bilstein Group serves a diverse clientele, including independent workshops, fleet managers, automotive distributors, and individual vehicle owners, ensuring that they meet the demands of both traditional and alternative fuel vehicles. The company prides itself on its commitment to quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction, positioning itself as a reliable partner in the global automotive aftermarket. With a focus on enhancing vehicle performance and longevity, Bilstein Group offers a comprehensive range of products, including technical wear parts, electronic components, and innovative repair solutions. The company actively advocates for the protection of the aftermarket industry and emphasizes the importance of sustainable practices in its operations. Bilstein Group's strong global network and partnerships with various manufacturers enable it to adapt to market changes and maintain its status as a trusted name in the automotive sector. With a workforce of around 2,700 employees across 22 international subsidiaries, Bilstein Group is well-equipped to meet the evolving needs of its clients and contribute to the future of the automotive aftermarket.

column43: IAV GmbH is a leading engineering service provider specializing in the automotive and mobility sectors, with a strong focus on developing innovative solutions for electrification, autonomous driving, and digital engineering. Founded in 1983 as a spinoff from the Technical University of Berlin, IAV has evolved into a key player in the mobility sector, dedicated to enhancing vehicle efficiency and sustainability. The company's mission, "We move the world for the better through technology and engineering," reflects its commitment to sustainability across ecological, economic, and social dimensions. IAV collaborates closely with major original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and technology partners, including AWS, Microsoft, and TSystems, to deliver cutting-edge mobility solutions that address the challenges of modern transportation. With a global presence and subsidiaries in key markets such as the USA, India, and China, IAV is well-positioned to meet diverse client needs and adapt to local market demands. The company serves a wide range of clients, including renowned automotive manufacturers, suppliers, public transport operators, and companies in sectors like energy, agriculture, and robotics. IAV emphasizes a culture of responsibility, innovation, and partnership, actively engaging its employees and stakeholders in shaping its strategic direction. IAV is committed to sustainability, aiming to achieve climate neutrality by 2025 and supporting the UN Global Compact's sustainability goals. The company prioritizes diversity and equal opportunities, fostering a culture that encourages the representation of women in leadership roles. Through participation in major industry events like CES, IAV showcases its latest innovations and reinforces its position as a key player in the evolving landscape of automotive technology. By leveraging its technological expertise and fostering a culture of innovation, IAV aims to create a positive impact on society and the environment, driving sustainable progress in the automotive industry.

column43: Brenntag is the global market leader in chemicals and ingredients distribution. The company holds a central role in connecting customers and suppliers of the chemical industry. Headquartered in Essen, Germany, Brenntag has more than 17,000 employees worldwide and operates a network of about 700 sites in 78 countries.  In 2022, Brenntag generated sales of around 19.4 billion EUR. The two global divisions, Brenntag Essentials and Brenntag Specialties, provide a full-line portfolio of industrial and specialty chemicals and ingredients as well as tailormade application, marketing and supply chain solutions, technical and formulation support, comprehensive regulatory know-how, and digital solutions for a wide range of industries.  In the field of sustainability, Brenntag pursues specific goals and is committed to sustainable solutions in its own sector and the industries served.  Brenntag shares have been listed at the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2010, initially in the MDAX and since September 2021 in the DAX. In addition, the Brenntag SE shares are listed in the DAX 50 ESG and DAX ESG Target.  For more information, visit www.brenntag.com

The association's members are integral to the mobility ecosystem, catering to a wide range of clients, including corporate fleets and individual consumers seeking flexible vehicle solutions. Through its efforts, BVRLA aims to enhance the operational efficiency of its members while supporting the broader goal of reducing carbon emissions in the transport sector. column43: itsu is a pioneering fast-food company that specializes in Asian-inspired, health-focused cuisine, offering a menu that is nutritious, affordable, and made fresh on-site. Founded in 1997 by Julian Metcalfe, itsu aims to provide a "health[ier]" alternative to traditional fast food, emphasizing the use of high-quality, sustainable ingredients and cooking methods that prioritize steaming over frying. The company is dedicated to promoting health and happiness through its offerings, which include protein-packed, plant-based dishes rich in fresh vegetables and whole grains.  itsu serves a diverse clientele, including health-conscious consumers and families, and partners with organizations like Vitality Insurance to encourage healthier lifestyle choices. With a strong focus on sustainability and community education, itsu invests in initiatives like the Community Kitchen Project, which teaches nutrition to young people, ensuring that enjoying health[ier] food is accessible and enjoyable for all.  As a leading Asian-inspired quick-service retail and grocery brand, itsu operates over 80 restaurants across the UK, Belgium, and France, alongside a growing wholesale business throughout Europe and beyond. column43: Jacobs Babtie, a subsidiary of Jacobs Engineering Group, is a global leader in providing integrated engineering, design, and consulting services across various sectors, including infrastructure, environmental management, and water resources. The company is dedicated to addressing some of the world's most pressing challenges by delivering innovative solutions that promote sustainability and resilience. With a mission to create a more connected and sustainable world, Jacobs Babtie collaborates with a diverse range of clients, including government agencies, private sector organizations, and communities, to enhance the livability and connectivity of urban environments. The firm emphasizes integrity and ethical practices in all its operations, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. Jacobs Babtie has a strong focus on water management, having pioneered water reuse programs since the 1960s, and offers a comprehensive range of services from feasibility studies to design, construction, and operations. The company serves a diverse clientele, including municipalities and utility companies, and has established partnerships that enhance its capabilities in operational technology and cybersecurity, particularly in the water sector. With a workforce of over 60,000 professionals and annual revenues of approximately $16 billion, Jacobs Babtie is well-positioned to lead in the digital transformation and climate response sectors. The company is committed to fostering resilient environments and thriving cities, aiming to create lasting positive impacts through its comprehensive consulting, technical, and project delivery services. Jacobs Babtie's mission emphasizes sustainability and social equity, integrating these principles into its projects to deliver positive outcomes for communities and the environment. column43: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co., Ltd. (JAPEX) is a leading Japanese upstream company engaged in oil and natural gas exploration and production (E&P) activities both in Japan and overseas. Its main operating areas are Hokkaido, Akita, Yamagata and Niigata in Japan. Overseas, JAPEX is active in Canada, Indonesia, Libya, Iraq and other regions where it has offshore interests. JAPEX was founded in December 1955 as a special-purpose company through a government initiative and has continued to explore and produce oil and natural gas in Japan while expanding its activities overseas. Between 1967 and 1970, JAPEX was incorporated into the Japan Petroleum Development Corporation (JPDC) as its E&P  operating body. Thereafter, JAPEX was separated and re-established as a privatesector company under the former Commercial Code in April 1970. JAPEX listed on the First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in December 2003.

Care for this company was resumed by his Majesty the late King Al Hussein Bin Talal (peace and mercy of God be upon him) during his prosperous time, the company has been granted its second concession in 1962 for fifty years after the Central Electric Company of Jordan merged with it where the concession of the new company has offered it the right to generate, transmit, transfer and distribute electric power in a region extending from Wadi Al-Dleil in the north to Theiban in the south and from the Mowagar in the east to the threshold of the Jordan valley (Al-Aghwar) in the west, which is the border of the concession area of the company. Today, JEPCO is responsible for distributing electrical energy for about (66%) of the total consumers in the country. Forward planning and forecasting to meet the growing demands of the consumers has been JEPCO's well entrenched philosophy.
