column43: John Crane, founded in 1917 and headquartered in Slough, United Kingdom, is a leading global provider of engineered technology solutions, specializing in mechanical seals, couplings, and filtration systems for the energy and process industries. With a mission to pioneer mission-critical products that enable efficient and sustainable operations, John Crane is dedicated to protecting the planet's resources through innovative engineering solutions. The company serves a diverse clientele across various sectors, including oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, and chemical processing, leveraging a vast network of over 195 global sites and more than 6,000 employees. As part of Smiths Group plc, John Crane is recognized for its commitment to quality, reliability, and environmental stewardship, aiming to accelerate the transition to renewable energy and meet the latest environmental standards. John Crane's innovative products are designed to optimize performance and enhance operational efficiency while addressing sustainability challenges, including climate change and the transition to net-zero emissions. The company partners with major energy producers, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), and manufacturing facilities, providing tailored solutions that reduce maintenance costs and improve operational efficiency. With nearly 30 years of expertise in carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS), John Crane is committed to investing in next-generation technologies that facilitate the decarbonization of energy-intensive sectors. The company actively participates in global initiatives, such as the United Nations Race to Zero campaign, targeting net-zero emissions by 2040 for Scope 1 and 2, and by 2050 for Scope 3 emissions. John Crane's vision is to pioneer advancements that not only meet current industry challenges but also drive future sustainability efforts, ensuring a resilient energy ecosystem. Through its legacy of innovation and service excellence, John Crane empowers customers to navigate the challenges of a rapidly changing energy landscape, making it a vital partner in the pursuit of cleaner energy alternatives and operational excellence.

Kelvion's mission is to empower customers to achieve reliable, efficient, and sustainable operations, while its vision highlights the significance of digitalization and the green transition in addressing the needs of growing populations and rising living standards. With a strong commitment to sustainability, Kelvion collaborates with clients and partners worldwide, ensuring that its extensive portfolio of products and services supports the energy transition and resource efficiency goals of its customers. The company offers a variety of advanced technology products, such as gasketed plate exchangers, dry coolers, and industrial heat pumps, designed to enhance energy efficiency and sustainability. Kelvion serves a diverse clientele, including major players in the energy sector, data centers, and food processing companies, and works closely with partners to develop customized solutions that meet specific operational needs. Kelvion's global sales, service, and production network enables it to provide comprehensive support, optimizing performance and extending product lifecycles for clients across various markets. By focusing on innovative cooling solutions and heat exchangers, Kelvion aims to drive the transition towards renewable energy and improve overall system performance, reinforcing its position as a key player in the thermal management industry.

column43: Kaba Group, from RÃ¼mlang in Zurich (Switzerland), and Dorma Group, based in Ennepetal near DÃ¼sseldorf (Germany), merged to form dormakaba in September 2015. The merger has created one of the top three companies in the global market for security and access solutions, with pro forma sales of more than CHF 2 billion and around 16,000 employees. dormakaba is active in over 50 countries and has a presence, through both production sites and distribution and service offices, in all relevant markets. Together, the two companies offer their customers a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions and services for security and building access, so these customers can get everything relating to access and opening and closing doors from a single source. The portfolio includes locking systems â€“ from cylinders, keys and locks right through to fully networked electronic access solutions â€“ but also physical access systems and automatic door systems, as well as a comprehensive range of door hinges and fittings,  door controls. column43: La Vie En Rose is a prominent Canadian retailer that specializes in women's lingerie, sleepwear, and swimwear, dedicated to offering stylish and comfortable apparel. Established in 1985 and headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, the company has expanded to operate 294 stores across Canada and employs over 4,700 individuals. La Vie En Rose's mission is to empower women by providing a diverse range of products that celebrate femininity and self-expression, catering to women of all ages and sizes. The brand operates under two main banners: La Vie en Rose and Bikini Village, ensuring a wide selection for its clientele. With a strong commitment to quality and sustainability, La Vie En Rose aims to create a positive impact in the fashion industry. The company actively engages in ethical practices, working to prevent forced and child labor within its supply chain through a Partner Code of Conduct and thorough due diligence on its manufacturers. Sourcing products from international suppliers in countries such as Bangladesh, China, and India, La Vie En Rose emphasizes transparency and collaboration throughout its operations. In addition to its retail presence, the brand collaborates with local partners and participates in community events, reinforcing its dedication to supporting local businesses and promoting ethical practices. Through innovative designs and a customer-centric approach, La Vie En Rose strives to enhance the shopping experience and foster a sense of confidence among its customers. By prioritizing social responsibility alongside quality products, La Vie En Rose continues to solidify its position as a leader in the women's apparel market.

Crocodile brand is today present in 120 countries through a selective distribution network. Two Lacoste items are sold every second in the world. As an international Group gathering 10,000 women and men, Lacoste offers a complete range of products: apparel, leather goods, fragrances, footwear, eyewear, home wear, watches and underwear, all of them being elaborated in the most qualitative, responsible and ethical way. column43: Li Ning Company Limited is one of the leading sports brand enterprises in the PRC, possessing brand marketing, research and development, design, manufacturing, distribution and retail capabilities. The Group's products include footwear, apparel, accessories and equipment for sport and leisure uses. The Group has established an extensive supply chain management system, and a distribution and retail network in the PRC primarily through outsourcing of manufacturing operations and distribution via franchised agents. The Group also directly manages retail stores for the LI-NING brand. The Group adopts a multi-brand business development strategy. In addition to its core LI-NING brand, the Group distributes sports products under its Z-DO brand via hypermarket channel. The Group has established a joint venture with AIGLE under which the joint venture has been granted an exclusive right by AIGLE to manufacture, market, distribute and sell outdoor sports products under the French brand AIGLE for 50 years in the PRC. In 2008, the Group acquired a controlling interest in Double Happiness, which together with its subsidiaries, are principally engaged in manufacturing, research and development, marketing and sale of table tennis and other sports equipment under the Double Happiness brand. The company promotes values such as quality, sincerity, and optimism, while also supporting women and cultural initiatives. The company's vision includes a strong commitment to corporate responsibility and environmental sustainability, striving to reduce its ecological footprint while supporting its customers in achieving their own sustainability goals. With a workforce of over 23,000 employees, Lufthansa Technik fosters a culture of collaboration and individual development, ensuring that every employee contributes to the company's mission of advancing the aviation industry. As it continues to expand its global footprint, Lufthansa Technik remains dedicated to maintaining high standards of quality and safety in all its services.

With a strong emphasis on corporate social responsibility, MAG aims to enhance the UK's global connectivity while prioritizing inclusivity and diversity within its workforce. The organization fosters a workplace that values diversity and provides reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities, ensuring that all employees can thrive. MAG continues to invest in its infrastructure and services to meet the evolving needs of its passengers and the regions it serves, with a focus on operational excellence and customer satisfaction. column43: GKN Automotive is a leading global automotive technology company that specializes in the design, manufacture, and supply of advanced driveline systems and electric powertrain technologies. With a rich history dating back to 1759, GKN Automotive has established itself as a trusted partner for over 90% of the world's original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), providing critical components such as sideshafts and eDrive systems for electrified vehicles. The company's mission is to drive a cleaner, more sustainable world by pioneering electric drive systems and supporting the transition to electrification in the automotive sector. GKN Automotive operates across 46 manufacturing locations in 18 countries, employing over 25,000 people dedicated to innovation and sustainability. The company is committed to achieving net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2045 and actively engages in responsible sourcing practices to eliminate conflict minerals and modern slavery from its supply chain. GKN Automotive invests significantly in research and development to enhance product efficiency and reduce emissions, ensuring its technologies contribute to safer, smarter, and more efficient vehicles. Its target market includes major automotive manufacturers globally, and the company collaborates with partners across the industry to develop cutting-edge technologies that meet the evolving needs of the automotive market. In addition to its focus on innovation, GKN Automotive is dedicated to ethical business practices, fostering a culture of transparency and accountability through ongoing training and a robust whistleblowing policy. The company also engages in community support and STEM education initiatives, reflecting its commitment to social responsibility. With a vision centered on driving the future of mobility, GKN Automotive is well-positioned to lead the transition to a decarbonized automotive sector, ensuring that its advanced driveline technologies play a crucial role in shaping the future of transportation.

column43: GKN plc, a prominent global engineering company and part of the Dowlais Group, specializes in advanced manufacturing solutions, particularly in the fields of powder metallurgy, automotive, and hydrogen sectors. Through its division GKN Powder Metallurgy, the company is recognized as a leader in providing innovative and sustainable metal powder solutions, components, and applications tailored for automotive and industrial markets. With a dedicated workforce of over 5,000 experts across 28 manufacturing locations worldwide, GKN is committed to transforming complex challenges into efficient, high-quality products that meet the evolving demands of its clients. The company's mission emphasizes sustainability and innovation, aiming to minimize environmental impact while delivering best-in-class technology. GKN collaborates closely with a diverse clientele, including major automotive manufacturers, serving approximately 90% of global vehicle manufacturers. This collaboration enables GKN to develop tailored solutions that enhance performance and efficiency, particularly in the growing field of electrification, where the company is expanding its capabilities in permanent magnets for electric vehicles. GKN Powder Metallurgy is also dedicated to achieving net-zero greenhouse gas emissions and advancing the circular economy through eco-friendly manufacturing practices. In addition to its automotive focus, GKN Hydrogen is pioneering proprietary metal hydride technology for safe and efficient hydrogen storage, catering to various industrial applications. With over 75 manufacturing facilities across 19 countries and a workforce exceeding 30,000 employees, GKN plc is not only a leader in sintered metal products but also a company committed to ethical practices, strong supplier relationships, and high standards in human rights and environmental responsibility.

column43: Middle East Airlines was founded on May 31, 1945 by Saeb Salam, with operational and technical support from BOAC, with three de Havilland DH.89A Rapides. Operations started on January 1, 1946 with a service between Beirut and Nicosia, followed by flights to Iraq, Egypt, Syria, and Cyprus. Two Douglas DC-3s were acquired in mid-1946. Pan Am acquired a stake and management contract in September 1949. Pan Am was replaced when BOAC acquired 49% of MEA's shares in 1955. A Vickers Viscount was introduced in October 1955 while an Avro York cargo aircraft was leased in June 1957. On December 15, 1960, the first of four de Havilland Comet 4Cs arrived. After the association with BOAC ended on August 16, 1961, MEA was merged with Air Liban on June 7, 1963 which gave Air France a 30% holding, since relinquished. The full title was then Middle East Airlines Air Liban. In 1963 MEA also took over Lebanese International Airways. The fleet was modernised with the addition of three Sud Aviation Caravelles, in April 1963

The company is dedicated to social responsibility, actively engaging in local community initiatives and sponsoring sports teams and events in the regions where it operates. column43: M-KOPA is a pioneering UK-based fintech platform that operates across five African markets, including Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa. Founded in 2010, the company specializes in providing affordable financial and digital products to "Every Day Earners," a demographic often underserved by traditional financial institutions. M-KOPA's innovative financing model allows customers to access essential products, such as smartphones and solar energy solutions, through flexible daily micropayments, making technology and financial services accessible to a broader audience. The company's mission is to enhance digital inclusion and promote financial empowerment by offering financing solutions that align with the cash flow of individuals who earn their income daily. With over $1.5 billion in credit disbursed to more than 5 million customers, M-KOPA has established itself as a leader in the fintech space, focusing on low to middle-income consumers. The company partners with local agents, technology providers, and financial institutions to enhance service delivery and expand its reach, ensuring that clients can make manageable payments without the need for formal income or collateral. M-KOPA's vision is to redefine financial services for millions, empowering individuals to improve their livelihoods and achieve their financial goals. In addition to smartphones, M-KOPA offers a range of digital services, including digital loans, health insurance, and device protection, further supporting its clients' transition into the digital economy. The company is committed to sustainability and social impact, recently launching initiatives focused on electric mobility to support climate goals in Kenya. By addressing critical challenges like youth unemployment and the digital divide, M-KOPA not only empowers individuals with access to essential technology but also contributes to broader economic growth and environmental sustainability in the region.

Monde Nissin's commitment to sustainability is evident in its initiatives to reduce plastic waste, improve packaging sustainability, and engage in community development projects. The company targets a wide demographic, including health-conscious consumers and families seeking convenient meal solutions, positioning itself as a trusted brand in the competitive food industry. Monde Nissin's vision emphasizes resilience and adaptability, ensuring it remains responsive to market trends and consumer demands. Through continuous investment in research and development, Monde Nissin aims to maintain its leadership position in the food sector while fostering positive change in the communities it serves.

column43: National Energy Action (NEA) is a prominent independent charity committed to eradicating fuel poverty across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland. With a mission to ensure that everyone can afford to live in a warm, safe, and healthy home, NEA focuses on providing essential energy advice and support services to vulnerable households. NEA collaborates with a diverse range of partners, including local authorities, housing associations, health bodies, and energy suppliers, to deliver impactful programs such as the Warming Communities initiative and the Warm Homes, Healthy Futures program. These initiatives are designed to empower marginalized groups facing fuel poverty and connect vulnerable individuals with critical energy-related support. NEA's target market includes low-income households, elderly individuals, and those living in cold, damp, and unhealthy homes, striving to give a voice to those who often suffer in silence. With over 40 years of experience, NEA is dedicated to driving better health and wellbeing outcomes for those struggling to heat their homes. The organization provides direct support through its Energy Advice and Support Service, offering guidance on energy efficiency, financial assistance, and access to various government schemes. Through its community-driven approach and extensive network, NEA aims to dismantle barriers to energy access and foster sustainable change in the lives of those it serves, ultimately working towards the complete eradication of fuel poverty.

column43: The National Energy System Operator (NESO) is an independent public corporation established under the UK's 2023 Energy Act, responsible for overseeing the planning and operation of Great Britain's entire energy system, which includes both electricity and gas. NESO's mission is to facilitate the transition to a cleaner, more secure, and affordable energy future by adopting a whole system approach that integrates various energy sources and technologies. The organization is dedicated to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050 and aims to ensure that energy supply continuously meets demand while balancing the needs of diverse stakeholders, including industry participants, communities, and consumers. Building on the expertise of its predecessor, the Electricity System Operator (ESO), NESO plays a pivotal role in transforming Great Britain's electricity system, with a focus on achieving a fully decarbonised energy landscape by 2035. The organization collaborates closely with government bodies and regulatory agencies like Ofgem to develop coordinated strategies that align national and local energy needs, enhancing system resilience and consumer benefits. NESO's target market encompasses energy producers, consumers, and various stakeholders in the energy sector, as it seeks to optimize the use of existing assets and streamline infrastructure planning. In addition to its operational responsibilities, NESO is committed to promoting digital transformation within the energy sector. It reviews and prioritizes digitalization initiatives from both public and private sectors, ensuring stakeholder needs are effectively channeled into actionable recommendations for sector governing bodies. NESO's strategic partnerships extend to international energy organizations, enhancing global cooperation in the transition to low-carbon energy systems. By integrating data and insights from across the energy system, NESO aims to create a unified digital infrastructure that supports the ambitious goal of achieving clean power by 2030, contributing to the overall energy security and sustainability of the nation. Through its commitment to innovation, collaboration, and inclusivity, NESO is dedicated to shaping a sustainable future that prioritizes environmental safeguarding and community values.

The organization emphasizes consumer value and operational efficiency while fostering transparency and customer-centricity. Its strategic initiatives, such as the Virtual Energy System (VirtualES) program, aim to enhance data sharing and decision-making across the energy sector. With a vision to be at the heart of a clean, fair, and affordable energy future, National Grid ESO is committed to ethical practices, diversity, and inclusion, employing over 31,000 people globally and collaborating with around 17,000 suppliers. The company serves a wide market, targeting renewable energy sources, traditional power generation, and ancillary service providers, all aimed at maintaining grid stability and efficiency. Through collaboration and innovation, National Grid ESO aspires to inspire collective action towards a sustainable energy future for all.

column43: The National Nuclear Laboratory (NNL) is the UKâ€™s premier civil national laboratory dedicated to advancing nuclear fission and its applications for societal benefit. Established in 2008 and owned by the UK Government, NNL operates with a mission to tackle critical challenges such as energy independence, national security, and achieving net zero emissions. With a workforce of approximately 1,000 employees, including 450 scientists, NNL focuses on four strategic areas: Clean Energy, Environmental Restoration, Health and Nuclear Medicine, and Security and Non-Proliferation. The laboratory is committed to providing expert technical advice and innovative solutions across the entire nuclear fuel cycle, from fuel manufacture and power generation to waste treatment and disposal. NNL collaborates with a diverse range of partners, including government entities, academic institutions, and industry stakeholders such as Sellafield Ltd and the Nuclear Decommissioning Authority (NDA). These collaborations drive innovation and ensure the UK maintains its capabilities in nuclear technology. NNL is also involved in international research projects under frameworks like Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe, enhancing its capabilities and fostering global knowledge exchange.  The organization is dedicated to nurturing the next generation of nuclear experts through initiatives like the NNL Fellowship, which supports technical leadership within the field. By leveraging its world-class expertise and fostering strategic partnerships, NNL aims to position the UK as a global leader in nuclear science and technology. Its work encompasses a range of areas, including materials performance, decontamination, and the development of advanced waste management technologies, all aimed at supporting the UK's transition to a sustainable energy future. Through its commitment to research excellence and collaboration, NNL plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of nuclear technology and environmental stewardship, ensuring safe and efficient management of the UK's nuclear legacy.

The global organization specializes in designing, engineering, commissioning and service complex applications with electric motors and generators up to 65 MW power (87,000 hp), electronic power converters and inverters, automation and software for industrial processes, retrofitting of power plants and hydroelectric generators. column43: The development, manufacture, project management and servicing of wind turbines in the onshore segment has been the core competence and passion of the Nordex Group and its more than 9,000 employees worldwide for over 35 years.  As one of the world's largest wind turbine manufacturers, the Nordex Group offers high-yield, cost-efficient wind turbines that enable long-term and economical power generation from wind energy in all geographical and climatic conditions. The focus is on turbines in the 3 to 6 MW+ class, and the Groupâ€™s comprehensive product portfolio offers individual solutions for both markets with limited space and regions with limited grid capacities. A global service network, with some 350 service points throughout 30 countries, delivers service quickly to keep our systems running smoothly. The Group covers the needs of all customer segments within the global wind market, from large energy suppliers to SMEs operating power plants. With more than 45 GW of installed capacity worldwide, Nordex Group systems deliver sustainable energy throughout more than 80 per cent of the worldâ€™s energy market (excluding China).  Nordex SE is listed on the TecDAX and MDAX of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (ISIN: DE000A0D6554). The management holding company is headquartered in Rostock, while the executive board and administrative offices are based in Hamburg. At production facilities in Germany, Spain, Brazil, the US, and India, the Nordex Group produces its own nacelles, rotor blades and concrete towers. The Group also maintains offices and branches in more than 30 countries.

column43: Nordson Corp. engages in the engineering, manufacture and market of products and systems used for adhesives, coatings, sealants, biomaterials and other materials. The company is headquartered in Westlake, Ohio and currently employs 8,000 full-time employees.  The firm engineers, manufactures and markets differentiated products and systems used for precision dispensing, applying and controlling adhesives, coatings, polymers, sealants, biomaterials, and other fluids, to test and inspect for quality, and to treat and cure surfaces and various medical products. Its segments include Industrial Precision Solutions, Medical and Fluid Solutions and Advanced Technology Solutions. The Industrial Precision Solutions segment delivers dispensing and material processing technology to diverse end markets. This segment serves the consumer durables, non-durables, agricultural and industrial markets. The Medical and Fluid Solutions segment includes fluid management solutions for medical, high-tech industrial and other diverse end markets. The Companyâ€™s Advanced Technology Solutions segment integrates its product technologies into the progressive stages of a customerâ€™s production processes.

column43: Northern Powergrid is a leading electricity distribution network operator in the UK, responsible for delivering power to over 8 million customers across the North East, Yorkshire, and northern Lincolnshire. The company is dedicated to providing a reliable and resilient electricity supply while facilitating the transition to a low-carbon economy. Northern Powergrid actively collaborates with a diverse range of stakeholders, including local authorities, community organizations, and energy suppliers, to enhance service delivery and address challenges such as fuel poverty and climate change. The company is committed to innovation, investing in advanced technologies like smart grid solutions, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and renewable energy connections to support the integration of low-carbon technologies into its operations. With a vision to empower communities and improve customer satisfaction, Northern Powergrid aims to achieve net zero operations by 2040. The company engages in various community outreach programs and initiatives, such as the Community Partnering Fund, to promote energy efficiency and sustainability. By leveraging open data and transparency, Northern Powergrid provides stakeholders with essential information about its network and services, fostering informed decision-making. The company serves a diverse clientele, including residential customers, commercial enterprises, and local authorities, and partners with organizations like Leeds University to drive innovation in energy efficiency. Through its strategic focus on environmental responsibility and community engagement, Northern Powergrid is committed to building a sustainable energy future that benefits all its customers and the communities it serves.

column43: Ocado Retail is a leading online supermarket in the United Kingdom, operating as a 50:50 joint venture between Ocado Group and Marks & Spencer Group. The company is dedicated to providing an extensive range of grocery and lifestyle products to over one million active customers, focusing on delivering an exceptional shopping experience. Its mission is to enhance customer lives by delivering the supermarket of tomorrow today, emphasizing unbeatable choice, unrivaled service, and reassuringly good value. Ocado Retail offers a diverse product selection that includes M&S favorites, big brands, and a growing array of independent brands, catering to the varied needs of its customer base. The company operates through its innovative technology-driven platform, the Ocado Smart Platform, which streamlines operations and enhances the online shopping experience. With a commitment to sustainability, Ocado Retail aims to achieve net-zero emissions by 2040 and actively works to reduce food waste while promoting healthy eating. The company also partners with charities to address food insecurity, reflecting its dedication to community support and social responsibility. Ocado Retail primarily serves individual consumers seeking convenient grocery shopping solutions, including health-conscious families and busy professionals. Its innovative services, such as same-day delivery through Zoom by Ocado, further enhance the convenience of grocery shopping. The company values customer feedback and engages in transparent communication with its suppliers, ensuring compliance with ethical business practices and regulatory standards. By leveraging technology and operational efficiencies, Ocado Retail aims to redefine the grocery shopping landscape in the UK while driving growth and profitability in the evolving online grocery market.

column43: KAZ Minerals is one of the largest copper producers in Kazakhstan, boasting a rich history of over 80 years in the region. The company operates multiple mining assets, including the large-scale open-pit mines at Aktogay and Bozshakol, as well as several underground mines in Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan. With a mission to become the leading natural resources company in Central Asia, KAZ Minerals focuses on sustainable copper production to support the transition to low-carbon energy and infrastructure development. The company generated revenues of $4.3 billion in 2023, highlighting its significant role in the global copper supply chain, primarily targeting customers in China and Europe. KAZ Minerals is committed to responsible mining practices, emphasizing high standards of corporate governance and stakeholder engagement, which includes employees, local communities, and government entities. The company prioritizes safety and environmental sustainability, aiming for continuous improvement in its operational practices and community contributions. It actively invests in local development projects and educational initiatives to foster growth in the regions where it operates. With a workforce of approximately 14,000 employees, KAZ Minerals serves a diverse client base in the mining sector and collaborates with numerous contractors and suppliers to enhance its production capabilities. The company is also focused on driving efficiencies and promoting a lower carbon economy through innovative technologies and practices. Additionally, KAZ Minerals is developing the Baimskaya copper project in Russia, further expanding its resource portfolio. Overall, KAZ Minerals is dedicated to delivering industry-leading production growth while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainable practices and operational excellence.

The company partners with local experts to curate unique shore experiences, allowing travelers to immerse themselves in the culture and beauty of each destination. P&O Cruises is committed to community investment and minimizing its environmental impact through initiatives such as the introduction of liquefied natural gas (LNG) powered ships and waste reduction programs. Recognized as Britain's favorite cruise line, P&O Cruises has won numerous awards voted by guests and travel agents, reflecting its dedication to customer satisfaction. The company also fosters a sense of community among its guests through its loyalty program, the Peninsular Club, which offers exclusive benefits to returning travelers. With a focus on innovation and quality service, P&O Cruises continues to evolve its offerings to meet the desires of modern travelers seeking both adventure and relaxation on the high seas.

column43: Patheon, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) that specializes in providing comprehensive solutions for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. With a robust network of facilities across 25 countries, Patheon partners with over 120 biotech and pharmaceutical companies, providing tailored solutions for small molecules, large molecules, and advanced therapies. The company emphasizes innovation and operational excellence, leveraging advanced technologies and a commitment to quality to meet the evolving needs of its customers. Patheon serves a diverse clientele, including major pharmaceutical companies and emerging biotech firms, ensuring that they receive the support and expertise necessary to navigate the complexities of drug development. In addition to its focus on quality and compliance, Patheon is committed to sustainability, actively working to mitigate environmental impacts and set ambitious targets to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. The company collaborates with various partners, including industry leaders and healthcare organizations, to enhance local manufacturing capabilities and increase access to next-generation medical technologies. Through its extensive global supply chain and partnerships, Patheon aims to foster long-term relationships that enhance patient health and safety worldwide, ultimately contributing to a healthier, cleaner, and safer world.

column43: PCM was founded in 1932 by RenÃ© Moineau, the inventor of the Progressing Cavity Pump (PCP). PCM Group is today a world leading supplier of solutions and fluid handling equipment for the Oil & Gas, Food and Industry. Our specialty is developing pumping solutions for the transfer and dosing of abrasive, fragile, viscous, corrosive, hot and heavy products. Present around the world, PCM provides a wide range of products including transfer, dosing, mixing and filling systems, progressing cavity pumps, peristaltic pumps for the Food and Industry markets as well as artificial lift and surface transfer pumps for the Oil & Gas sector. PCM services include engineering, commissioning, maintenance, co-development, consulting, training, spare parts, repairing and upgrading. PCM, whose headquarters is based in Levallois-Perret (France) operates on all continents in more than 90 countries through 6 industrial manufacturing sites, and more than 20 subsidiaries. The international development of the Group is constantly pursuing. The core of our business is the satisfaction of our customers, the health and the safety of our employees and the sustainability of the natural environments where we operate. Our ambition is to attain the highest level of quality within the Oil & Gas and Food & Industry markets and for all our products and services.

With a strong commitment to innovation and sustainability, Liebherr Mining aims to enhance productivity while minimizing environmental impact, aligning its operations with global trends towards reduced emissions and sustainable practices. The company's mission is to provide high-quality, reliable machinery that supports the mining sector's transition towards more sustainable practices, ensuring that clients can operate safely and efficiently in challenging environments. Liebherr Mining serves a diverse clientele, including major mining corporations across North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania, with a particular focus on markets like Australia and Indonesia, where demand for advanced mining equipment is robust.  Liebherr Mining collaborates with various partners and industry leaders to develop cutting-edge technologies, such as zero-emission mining solutions, exemplified by its recent initiatives to deliver hydrogen-powered and battery-electric machinery. The company emphasizes corporate responsibility, actively engaging in initiatives that promote environmental stewardship, employee welfare, and community support, ensuring a positive impact on society and the environment. With a workforce of over 54,000 employees and a presence in more than 150 countries, Liebherr Mining is dedicated to continuous improvement and innovation, striving to redefine industry standards while contributing to a sustainable future in mining operations worldwide. The division's vision encompasses a commitment to operational excellence and the creation of value through advanced technology and reliable performance, positioning Liebherr Mining as a trusted partner in the global mining market.

column43: Post Office Ltd is a leading provider of postal and financial services in the UK, operating the largest retail franchise network in Europe with over 11,500 branches. The company serves as a vital community hub, offering essential services such as mail delivery, banking, insurance, and retail products. With a mission to connect communities and support businesses, Post Office Ltd aims to provide reliable and accessible services to individuals and organizations across the nation. Its diverse clientele includes everyday consumers, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and larger corporate clients seeking dependable postal and banking solutions. The company is committed to a strong social purpose, focusing on enhancing postmaster remuneration and support through its "New Deal for Postmasters" initiative, which aims to ensure the sustainability of its branches. Post Office Ltd collaborates closely with strategic partners, including the National Federation of SubPostmasters, to improve operational efficiency and foster community engagement. The organization actively engages with its Postmasters, who are integral to its operations, ensuring they can effectively meet the needs of their local communities. In response to the evolving retail landscape and the decline of local high streets, Post Office Ltd is dedicated to innovation and customer satisfaction, adapting its services to meet modern consumer needs. The company also addresses past challenges, such as the Horizon IT scandal, with transparency and a commitment to redress. Through initiatives like the Branch MOTs, Post Office Ltd focuses on enhancing the retail experience and fostering community connections. With a vision to transform the Post Office to better serve postmasters and customers alike, the company is committed to maintaining its long-standing legacy while ensuring that essential services remain accessible, particularly in rural areas where banking services are increasingly scarce. By leveraging its extensive network and online platforms, Post Office Ltd strives to be a trusted partner for all postal and financial needs, ensuring that the dignity and rights of all individuals involved in its operations are respected.

column43: MAN Truck & Bus is one of Europe's leading manufacturers of commercial vehicles with production facilities in three European countries as well as in Russia, South Africa, and Turkey. Its product portfolio includes vans, trucks, buses/coaches, diesel and gas engines, and services for passenger and freight transportation. MAN Truck & Bus is thus a full-range supplier of commercial vehicles between three and 44 tons gross weight for every application, as well as special vehicles up to 250 tons gross weight. In addition to the ongoing maintenance and new development of its product ranges, MAN Truck & Bus is focusing on three key areas: alternative drive systems, digitalization, and automated driving. In line with its commercial vehicle portfolio, MAN Truck & Bus offers an increasingly comprehensive range of services from a single source. MAN Truck & Bus is thus transforming itself from a commercial vehicle manufacturer to a provider of intelligent and sustainable transport solutions. MAN Truck & Bus is a member of TRATON group. column43: QIAGEN is the leading global provider of Sample to Insight solutions that enable customers to gain valuable molecular insights from samples containing the building blocks of life.  Our sample technologies isolate and process DNA, RNA and proteins from blood, tissue and other materials. Assay technologies make these biomolecules visible and ready for analysis. Bioinformatics software and knowledge bases interpret data to report relevant, actionable insights. Automation solutions tie these together in seamless and cost-effective workflows.  QIAGEN provides solutions to more than 500,000 customers around the world in Molecular Diagnostics (human healthcare) and Life Sciences (academia, pharma R&D and industrial applications, primarily forensics).  As of December 31 2021 QIAGEN employed more than 6,000 people in over 35 locations worldwide. Further information can be found at www.qiagen.com

column43: The Real Farming Trust (RFT) is a UK-based charity dedicated to promoting agroecology and food justice through a variety of programs that unite individuals from diverse food and farming backgrounds. Central to its mission is the Oxford Real Farming Conference (ORFC), an influential annual event that has grown from a small gathering to a major conference attracting thousands of participants both in-person and online. RFT operates with core values of honesty, empathy, and compassion, striving to create inclusive and equitable spaces within the food and farming movement. The organization collaborates with a wide range of stakeholders, including farmers, activists, policymakers, and researchers, to advocate for sustainable food systems and address pressing social, racial, and environmental justice issues. Through initiatives such as the Twinning project and the Loans for Enlightened Agriculture Programme (LEAP), RFT empowers communities and supports small-scale agroecological enterprises, working towards the vision of "good food for everyone, forever." The Trust is committed to supporting small family farms and agroecological producers while advocating for environmental protections and standards in food and farming policies. Additionally, RFT serves as the secretariat for the Parliamentarians for Agroecology and Nature Friendly Food and Farming, facilitating dialogue and action on critical issues like soil health, climate change, and biodiversity loss. RFT's clients and partners include community groups, policymakers, and organizations focused on food security and sustainability, targeting a diverse market that encompasses both producers and consumers committed to ethical and environmentally friendly practices. Through its initiatives, the Real Farming Trust aims to create a resilient food system that benefits both people and the planet, fostering a sustainable future for all.

Collaborating with key partners such as Oracle and Heineken, Red Bull Racing leverages their expertise to enhance its competitive edge and expand its global reach. The organization targets a diverse audience of motorsport enthusiasts, corporate sponsors, and aspiring engineers, aiming to deliver thrilling racing experiences while inspiring the next generation of talent through educational initiatives like the Red Bull Academy Programme. Through community engagement and a focus on STEM fields, Red Bull Racing seeks to inspire young minds and ensure a diverse and inclusive future for motorsport. The team's dedication to excellence, innovation, and social responsibility positions it as a leader in the racing industry, continually striving to disrupt the status quo and achieve remarkable success on the world stage.

In the environmental market, it offers asset maintenance and renewals across water infrastructure networks.

column43: Renewi Plc engages in the provision of waste management services. The company is headquartered in Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire and currently employs 6,756 full-time employees.  The firm is a pure-play recycling company that focuses on extracting value from waste and used materials rather than disposing of them through incineration or landfill. The company uses technology to turn waste into useful materials, such as paper, metals, plastics, glass, wood, building materials, compost and water. Its segments include Commercial Waste, Mineralz & Water, Specialities, and Group central services. Commercial Waste segment is engaged in the collection and treatment of commercial waste in the Netherlands and Belgium. Mineralz & Water segment is engaged in the decontamination, stabilization, and re-use of highly contaminated materials to produce certified secondary products for the construction industry in the Netherlands and Belgium. Specialities segment is engaged in processing plants focusing on recycling and diverting specific waste streams. The company focuses on its core recycling business in the Netherlands, Belgium, France and Portugal.

column43: RH operates as a holding company which operates the business through its subsidiary Restoration Hardware, Inc. The company is headquartered in Corte Madera, California and currently employs 5,330 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2012-02-11. The firm offers merchandise assortments across a number of categories, including furniture, lighting, textiles, bathware, decor, outdoor and garden, and baby, child and teen furnishings. Its operating segments include RH Segment, Waterworks and Real Estate. The RH Segment and Waterworks operating segments include all sales channels accessed by its customers, including sales through retail locations and outlets, including hospitality, websites, Sourcebooks, and the Trade and Contract channels. The Real Estate segment represents operations associated with certain of its equity method investments and consolidated variable interest entities that are non-wholly-owned subsidiaries and have operations that are not directly related to RH's operations. The firm offers collections online at RH.com, RHContemporary, RHModern.com, RHBabyandChild.com, RHTEEN.com and Waterworks.com.

column43: Rheinmetall Technical Publications is a leading provider of comprehensive technical documentation and publications tailored for military and defense applications. As a key division of the Rheinmetall Group, the company is dedicated to enhancing the operational effectiveness of armed forces by delivering high-quality, precise, and user-friendly technical materials that support the maintenance and operation of advanced military systems. Its mission is to empower clients, including various branches of the military and defense contractors, by ensuring they have access to accurate and up-to-date information that adheres to international humanitarian law, including the Geneva and Hague Conventions. With a strong focus on innovation and quality, Rheinmetall Technical Publications aims to contribute to the safety and success of military operations worldwide. The company collaborates closely with partners in the defense sector to develop tailored solutions that meet the evolving needs of modern warfare. Its clientele includes a diverse range of military organizations, with a particular emphasis on the German armed forces, as well as international partners involved in defense and security sectors. Rheinmetall Technical Publications is committed to sustainability and aims to integrate environmentally responsible practices into its operations, aligning with Rheinmetall AG's broader vision of achieving CO2 neutrality by 2035. The company emphasizes the importance of environmental protection, personnel health and safety, and adherence to industry standards, positioning itself as a leader in technical publications within the defense industry. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and a commitment to excellence, Rheinmetall Technical Publications strives to be a trusted partner in delivering critical information that supports operational readiness and efficiency for its clients.

The company is headquartered in Denton, Texas and currently employs 27,000 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2006-11-13. Sally Beauty Supply is an omni-channel retailer that offers professional beauty supplies and provides education to retail consumers and salon professionals throughout North America, South America and Europe. Sally Beauty Supply stores offer up to 7,000 products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care through proprietary brands, such as Ion, Bondbar, Strawberry Leopard, and Generic Value Products. Beauty Systems Group stores, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its outside sales consultants, sell up to 8,000 professionally branded products, including Paul Mitchell, Wella, Matrix, Schwarzkopf, Kenra, Goldwell, Joico, Amika and Moroccanoil.

column43: SAOS Ltd is a leading organization based in Scotland, specializing in farmer cooperatives and fostering collaboration within the food industry. The company is dedicated to enhancing the profitability, competitiveness, and sustainability of food and farming businesses. With a mission to facilitate effective cooperation among farmers and food and drink enterprises, SAOS focuses on supply chain development, technology, innovation, and sustainability, addressing the complex challenges faced by the agricultural sector.  SAOS serves a diverse clientele that includes cooperatives, food producers, and various industry stakeholders, collaborating with partners to drive positive change in rural Scotland. Through its membership model, the organization offers unique services and training programs designed to develop the capabilities of its members, ensuring they are well-equipped to navigate the evolving landscape of the food and farming industry.  The vision of SAOS is to shape a resilient and sustainable future for agriculture by fostering collaboration and innovation across the sector. SAOS partners with industry experts and sponsors such as NFU Mutual and NFU Scotland to deliver expert masterclasses that provide practical insights and immersive learning experiences. Committed to personal and professional growth, SAOS aims to inspire individuals to make a lasting impact within their organizations and the agricultural sector at large. By addressing the unique needs of its clients, SAOS is actively shaping the future of leadership in a rapidly changing environment.

column43: Sappi is a leading global provider of powerful everyday materials made from woodfibre-based renewable resources. Together with our partners, we are moving quickly toward a more circular economy. Sappi works to build a thriving world by acting boldly to support the planet, people and prosperity.  Our products are manufactured from woodfibre sourced from sustainably-managed forests and plantations, in production facilities powered, in many cases, with bio-energy from steam and existing waste streams and many of our operations are energy self-sufficient. Our products include raw material offerings (such as dissolving pulp (DP), wood pulp and biomaterials as well as end-use products (packaging and speciality papers, graphic papers, casting and release papers and forestry products). Sappi has over 12,800 employees in over 35 countries and manufacturing operations on three continents (ten production facilities in Western Europe, four in North America and five in Southern Africa) which produce approximately: 5.7 million tons per year of paper 2.4 million tons per year of paper pulp, and 1.4 million tons per year of dissolving pulp. Our market-leading range of products is sold and distributed to our direct and indirect customer base across more than 150 countries. Learn more about us on our website.

column43: Niterra EMEA GmbH is a leading global supplier of technical ceramics and automotive components, with a strong focus on ignition products and vehicle electronics. Originally established as NGK Spark Plug (Germany) in 1979, the company has transformed and rebranded to Niterra, expanding its business beyond traditional combustion-engine components into diverse sectors such as mobility, medical, environment, energy, and communications. Headquartered in Ratingen, Germany, Niterra emphasizes sustainability and fosters a modern workplace culture that encourages collaboration and creativity among its employees. The company serves a wide range of clients, including major automotive manufacturers and the independent aftermarket, providing high-quality products such as spark plugs, glow plugs, ignition coils, and various sensors under its renowned brands NGK and NTK. Niterra's mission is to enhance the performance and efficiency of combustion engines while striving for environmental sustainability through cleaner technologies. The company is committed to innovation and excellence, aiming to maintain its leadership position in the automotive industry. Niterra collaborates with various motorsport teams, including Scuderia Ferrari and Xraid, to showcase its commitment to high-performance applications. With a comprehensive product portfolio that covers approximately 87% of vehicles in operation in Europe, Niterra is dedicated to delivering exceptional value and performance to its customers. The company also focuses on expanding its product offerings and developing cutting-edge digital strategies to meet the evolving needs of the automotive sector. Through its dedication to quality, technological advancement, and customer satisfaction, Niterra EMEA GmbH is poised to drive growth and profitability while contributing to a sustainable future.

Orano's mission is to ensure the safe and responsible use of nuclear energy while prioritizing environmental protection, safety, and social responsibility. The company operates across four continents, with significant mining sites in countries such as Kazakhstan, Niger, and Canada, and serves a diverse clientele that includes nearly 50% of the world's nuclear utilities, energy producers, and governmental organizations. Orano collaborates with various partners, including Cameco and Kazatomprom, to enhance its production capabilities and technological expertise. The company's vision emphasizes innovation and operational excellence, aiming to contribute to a low-carbon energy future and align with global sustainability goals. Orano is dedicated to responsible mining practices, focusing on safety, environmental stewardship, and community engagement, ensuring that its activities benefit both the environment and local populations.  In addition to its core operations, Orano is expanding into new areas such as medical applications and electric vehicle battery recycling, reflecting its commitment to innovation and the circular economy. The company actively engages with local communities and stakeholders to foster economic development and ensure that its operations align with societal expectations. Through its strategic initiatives, Orano aims to lead the nuclear sector in addressing climate change and resource preservation, positioning itself as a pivotal player in the transition to low-carbon energy solutions.

Our product offering covers 9 product ranges that include austenitic, ferritic, duplex and martensitic stainless steel grades. Outokumpu's production sites located in Finland, Germany, Mexico, Sweden, the UK and US produce a wide range of stainless steel products, covering hot and cold rolled coil products, quarto plate and long products in various grades and sizes. In addition, we have worldwide network of sales companies and service centers. Outokumpu has a unique competitive advantage through our own chrome mine and ferrochrome production in Finland. Outokumpu employs about 11 000 professionals in over 30 countries around the world. Its head office is located in Helsinki, Finland, and its share has been listed in the Nasdaq Helsinki since 1988.

column43: Perenco is a leading independent hydrocarbon company that specializes in the exploration, production, and development of mature and marginal oil and gas fields. Founded in 1992 by Hubert Perrodo, the company has established itself as a significant player in the energy sector, operating in 14 countries across Central Africa, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and Europe. Perenco's mission is to provide safe and innovative solutions for oil and gas production while maintaining a strong commitment to environmental sustainability and community development. The company aims to minimize its environmental impact through responsible waste management and biodiversity preservation initiatives, striving for zero accidents and pollution through rigorous safety and quality management systems. Perenco serves a diverse clientele, including local governments, energy consumers, and national and international oil companies. The company collaborates with various partners to enhance energy access and promote local economic development, particularly in developing countries where it addresses energy poverty and supports entrepreneurship. With a workforce of nearly 8,000 employees, Perenco emphasizes safety, responsibility, and excellence in all its operations, fostering a stimulating workplace that provides training and development opportunities. The company's vision includes becoming a leader in the sustainable exploitation of mature fields and contributing to the global energy transition by investing in innovative technologies and renewable energy sources. Perenco is dedicated to promoting health and safety, diversity, and community engagement, ensuring that its operations positively impact the regions in which it operates. Through its Perenco Foundation, the company seeks to reduce poverty and support local entrepreneurship, further solidifying its role as a responsible corporate citizen. Overall, Perenco is committed to balancing economic growth with environmental stewardship, aligning its operations with global sustainability initiatives while enhancing local economies and infrastructure.

The company invests significantly in research and development to stay at the forefront of sensor technology, ensuring it meets the evolving needs of its global customer base. With a strong focus on sustainability, SICK aims to achieve climate neutrality by 2030 and transition all its production sites to 100% green electricity by 2025. Through its commitment to innovation and quality, SICK Sensor Intelligence continues to drive advancements in sensor technology, helping clients achieve greater productivity and reliability in their operations.

column43: PETROFER is an internationally operating industrial company with headquarters in Hildesheim, Germany. PETROFER has made a name for itself worldwide as a leading manufacturer of industrial chemicals, speciality fluids and process media. PETROFER is a recognised industrial chemistry specialist that is constantly setting new technology standards. The results are high-tech, resource saving products with premium quality that optimise customer processes, save costs and increase production efficiency. A special aspect is the global responsibility for the environment, ecology and health. PETROFER thinks of the client first, developing customer specific, precisely engineered product solutions on request. column43: SK Innovation has been leading Koreaâ€™s energy industry for six decades. Determined to become an energy company with world-class technologies, SK Innovation dreams a bigger dream: Using green technologies to build a healthier planet. SK Innovation intends to cultivate its expertise in existing businesses, find new growth engines, and ultimately become a global "Green Energy & Materials Company." SK Innovation operates through 8 subsidiary companies: SK Energy, SK Geo Centric, SK On, SK Enmove, SK Incheon Petrochemical, SK Trading International, SK IE Technology, and SK Earthon. Their independent management structure enables each company to respond rapidly to changes in the global business environment and expedite growth through a fast decision-making process. Each company executes its own business strategy, consistent with its vision and optimized for its unique environment. SK Energy is the first and largest oil refiner in Korea. In 2013, SK Incheon Petrochemical and SK Trading International were split from SK Energy. SK Incheon Petrochemical focuses on high value-added petrochemical products, while SK Trading International trades petrochemical and crude oil products. SK Geo Centric, a global leader in the green chemicals and life sciences, is evolving into the largest "urban oilfield company" that converts plastic waste back into oil. SK Enmove is a world top player in the lubricants and base oil market, well recognized in European, North American and Asian markets. SK IE Technology established a foothold to become a global material solution company for information and electronic materials as it was physically divided from SK Innovation in 2019. SK IE Technology is leading the wet separator market with advanced LiBS (Lithium-ion Battery Separator), and a member of RE100. In October 2021, SK On and SK Earthon officially became new independent companies under SK Innovation after the spin-off of Battery Business and E&P Business, respectively.

column43: SOCOTEC is a leading provider of testing, inspection, and certification (TIC) services, dedicated to ensuring the safety, compliance, and sustainability of buildings, infrastructure, and industrial facilities. Established in 1953, the company operates in 26 countries and serves over 200,000 clients across various sectors, including construction, real estate, infrastructure, and manufacturing. SOCOTEC's mission is to support clients throughout the asset lifecycle by managing risks and enhancing environmental performance, while its vision emphasizes building trust for a safer and sustainable world. The company is committed to sustainability, with initiatives like its Green Trust services aimed at reducing carbon footprints and optimizing energy performance. SOCOTEC collaborates with numerous stakeholders, including government bodies and industry associations, to promote best practices in environmental and social responsibility, reflecting its dedication to corporate social responsibility and sustainable development. The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including energy audits, carbon assessments, and sustainability certifications, helping clients navigate the complexities of energy management and environmental transition. SOCOTEC serves a diverse clientele, including real estate developers, social housing organizations, and industrial facilities, and partners with various organizations to enhance the sustainability of buildings and infrastructure. With a strong focus on innovation and ethical practices, SOCOTEC aims to lead the way in addressing the pressing challenges of climate change and resource management. The company invests significantly in employee development, ensuring its workforce is equipped to meet the evolving demands of the TIC sector. SOCOTEC's commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions and promoting social inclusion is evident in its initiatives to train and employ young people and individuals with disabilities. Through its extensive network of partnerships and a dedicated workforce, SOCOTEC is well-positioned to address the evolving challenges of its target markets while fostering a culture of ethical practices and operational excellence.

column43: SR Technics UK Limited is a leading provider of Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) services in the aviation industry, with a specialization in aircraft engine maintenance and training solutions. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, the company has over 90 years of operational experience and is dedicated to ensuring safety, quality, and reliability in all its services. Its mission, encapsulated in the motto "We safely power your flight," reflects a commitment to excellence and customer-centricity, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and minimize downtime for its clients.  The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including specialized training programs for various aircraft types such as the Airbus A330, A340, and Boeing 737 families, as well as engine services for CFM56B and LEAP-1A engines. SR Technics UK Limited serves a diverse clientele, including major airlines like Allegiant Air and Airblue, aircraft leasing companies, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). The company has established strong partnerships with key players in the aerospace sector, including Safran Aircraft Engines and Pratt & Whitney, to enhance its service offerings and expand its capabilities. With a focus on continuous improvement and innovation, SR Technics UK Limited aims to double its business by 2028 while investing in new technologies and workforce development. The company emphasizes precision, accountability, and sustainability in its operations, contributing to the overall efficiency and safety of air travel. By collaborating with industry stakeholders and maintaining multiple regulatory approvals, including EASA and FAA certifications, SR Technics UK Limited is committed to upholding the highest standards of aviation safety and compliance. Through its skilled workforce of over 2,000 motivated employees, the company strives to be a trusted partner in the aviation industry, supporting the ongoing development of skilled personnel in aircraft maintenance and engineering.

SSP partners with major airports and rail operators to create tailored food and beverage experiences that meet the evolving needs of travelers. By prioritizing people, planet, and product, the company fosters an inclusive workplace and strives to make a positive impact on the communities in which it operates. column43: Stella McCartney is a pioneering luxury fashion brand founded in 2001 by the British designer of the same name, who has been a lifelong advocate for sustainability and animal rights. The company is renowned for its commitment to creating high-quality, stylish clothing and accessories without the use of leather, fur, or other animal-derived materials, positioning itself as a leader in the conscious luxury movement. Stella McCartney's mission is to innovate within the fashion industry by utilizing cutting-edge, sustainable materials and practices, such as vegan leather alternatives and eco-friendly production methods, while promoting transparency and circularity in its supply chain.  The brand specializes in women's ready-to-wear, accessories, and footwear, all crafted in alignment with its cruelty-free ethos. Stella McCartney targets a diverse clientele, including fashion-forward consumers and environmentally conscious individuals who value both style and ethical considerations. The company has established partnerships with major organizations, including adidas and the Ethical Trading Initiative, to enhance its impact and promote sustainable practices.  With a global presence in 77 countries, Stella McCartney operates numerous stores and sells its collections in over 800 specialty shops and department stores. The brand's vision emphasizes accountability for environmental and social impacts, striving to create a positive legacy through responsible sourcing and community engagement. Stella McCartney actively engages in modern slavery due diligence, conducting audits and assessments of its suppliers to ensure fair treatment of workers and safe working conditions. Through continuous training and improvement initiatives, the brand aims to empower its suppliers and foster a culture of social responsibility within the fashion industry, inspiring change and encouraging a shift towards a more sustainable future.

The firm collaborates closely with a diverse range of clients, including public authorities, private operators, and infrastructure managers, to deliver comprehensive services that encompass feasibility studies, operational readiness, systems integration, and project management.  SYSTRA's commitment to sustainability and social inclusion is reflected in its focus on enhancing urban infrastructure and improving the overall passenger experience. The company generates 74% of its turnover internationally, serving a diverse clientele that includes public transportation authorities, educational institutions, and housing agencies. Recently, SYSTRA welcomed new shareholders, Latour Capital and Fimalac, alongside legacy investors SNCF Group and RATP Group, to support its growth and international development strategy.  Through its innovative transport solutions, SYSTRA aims to revolutionize public transportation infrastructure and shape the mobility solutions of tomorrow, addressing the challenges of modern urban environments while promoting accessibility and connectivity for all.

column43: TDK Corporation is a world leader in electronic solutions for the smart society based in Tokyo, Japan. Built on a foundation of material sciences mastery, TDK welcomes societal transformation by resolutely remaining at the forefront of technological evolution and deliberately "Attracting Tomorrow." It was established in 1935 to commercialize ferrite, a key material in electronic and magnetic products. TDK's comprehensive, innovation-driven portfolio features passive components such as ceramic, aluminum electrolytic and film capacitors, as well as magnetics, high-frequency, and piezo and protection devices. The product spectrum also includes sensors and sensor systems such as temperature and pressure, magnetic, and MEMS sensors. In addition, TDK provides power supplies and energy devices, magnetic heads and more. These products are marketed under the product brands TDK, EPCOS, InvenSense, Micronas, Tronics and TDK-Lambda. TDK focuses on demanding markets in automotive, industrial and consumer electronics, and information and communication technology. The company has a network of design and manufacturing locations and sales offices in Asia, Europe, and in North and South America. In fiscal 2022, TDK posted total sales of USD 15.6 billion and employed about 117,000 people worldwide.

column43: Sidel is a leading provider of high-performance packaging solutions, with a specialization in the beverage, food, and home and personal care markets. With over 170 years of experience, the company is dedicated to innovation and sustainability, operating under the belief that packaged goods should be safe, accessible, and enjoyable for consumers. Sidel partners with producers worldwide to deliver integrated packaging lines that enhance product protection, desirability, and availability while minimizing environmental impact. As a member of the Tetra Laval Group, Sidel collaborates with renowned entities such as Tetra Pak and DeLaval, leveraging a robust network of expertise to meet the diverse needs of its clients. The company's clientele includes major brands in the beverage and food sectors, such as Twellium and Orkla, and Sidel is committed to creating tailored solutions that empower these customers to achieve their operational goals for future generations. Sidel specializes in turnkey packaging line solutions that enhance production performance, optimize line efficiency, and ensure high product quality and food safety. Its extensive portfolio encompasses technologies for various types of beverages and containers, including PET, glass, and cans, as well as food products in jars and cartons. Sidel is particularly focused on sustainability, aiming to future-proof packaging to meet evolving regulations and consumer demands, especially in the area of packaging circularity. The company's mission is to empower manufacturers to achieve operational excellence while maintaining a low total cost of ownership across their production processes. By continuously innovating and adapting to market trends, Sidel remains at the forefront of the packaging industry, dedicated to enhancing productivity and sustainability for its clients.

column43: Teradyne brings high-quality innovations such as smart devices, life-saving medical equipment and data storage systems to market, faster. Its advanced test solutions for semiconductors, electronic systems, wireless devices and more ensure that products perform as they were designed. Its robotics offerings include collaborative and mobile robots that help manufacturers of all sizes improve productivity and lower costs. Teradyne employs over 6,500 people worldwide. The Semiconductor Test Division is the world's largest supplier of semiconductor test equipment for logic, RF, analog, power, mixed-signal and memory technologies.  The System Test Group is a global leader in electronics testing solutions serving the world's leading original equipment manufacturers, electronics manufacturing services suppliers, and hard disk drive makers.  The Wireless Test segment, LitePoint, is focused on reducing the time to market and cost of system level test for wireless products operating on WiFi, Bluetooth, GPS, and cellular phone networks. Teradyne Robotics, consisting of Universal Robots and MiR, provides low-cost, easy-to-deploy and simple-to-program robots that work side by side with production workers to improve quality and increase manufacturing efficiency.

column43: SMS group is a leading global provider of innovative technologies and services for the metals industry, with a rich history dating back to 1871. The company specializes in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of machinery and plants for the production of steel, aluminum, and non-ferrous metals. With over 150 years of experience, SMS group is dedicated to advancing sustainable and carbon-neutral production methods, encapsulated in its mission of "turning metals green." The company focuses on decarbonization and the circular economy, aiming to meet the evolving demands of its diverse clientele, which includes major players in the steel and aluminum sectors such as Nucor and ThyssenKrupp. Employing approximately 14,000 professionals across more than 30 countries, SMS group fosters a culture of innovation and inclusivity, positioning itself as a trusted partner in shaping a sustainable future for the metals industry. The company places a strong emphasis on research and development, investing significantly in cutting-edge technologies and digital solutions that enhance efficiency and sustainability throughout the entire lifecycle of metallurgical plants. SMS group collaborates closely with various partners to tackle complex challenges in metallurgy, delivering tailored solutions that improve productivity and resource efficiency. With a comprehensive portfolio that includes automation, digital solutions, and environmental protection technologies, SMS group is committed to creating value for its customers while contributing positively to society and the environment. The company's vision is to lead the digital transformation in the metal industry, ensuring a sustainable and efficient future for its customers. Through strategic partnerships and a focus on customer-centric solutions, SMS group aims to address the challenges of climate change while maintaining high standards of quality and safety in all its operations.

Laboratory Products and Biopharma Services segment offers virtually everything needed for the laboratory.

column43: SPS Technology is a global leader in providing innovative structural repair solutions tailored for the maritime and offshore industries, with a particular focus on the Sandwich Plate System (SPS). With over 25 years of experience, the company is dedicated to enhancing the safety and longevity of vessels and offshore assets through the use of advanced composite materials. These materials not only eliminate the need for drydocking but also significantly reduce operational downtime, making repairs more efficient and cost-effective. SPS Technology's mission is to deliver class-approved repair methods that save time and money while promoting environmental sustainability by minimizing carbon emissions and material waste. The company serves a diverse clientele, including major oil and gas companies, shipowners, and engineering firms, and collaborates with industry partners to implement cutting-edge repair techniques. By focusing on innovation and quality, SPS Technology aims to revolutionize the standards of maritime repair and maintenance, ensuring the highest levels of safety and efficiency for its clients. In addition to its maritime solutions, SPS Technology specializes in modular building solutions that enhance construction efficiency, sustainability, and safety across various applications, including stadia, bridges, and commercial buildings. The company's mission in the construction sector is to revolutionize the industry by providing lightweight, prefabricated components that significantly reduce installation time and labor costs while maintaining full structural capacity. Their diverse clientele includes major construction firms and organizations involved in high-profile projects, such as the Seattle Space Needle renovation and the London Olympic Stadium transformation. By collaborating with a global network of partners, SPS Technology is committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that meet the evolving needs of both the maritime and construction markets, ultimately aiming to build a better tomorrow through sustainable practices and faster project completion.

SEE OUR WEBSITE FOR MORE DETAILS*** Trailstone is a global energy and technology company, operating at the intersection of renewable and conventional power. We trade energy in global markets, and we provide a best-in-class service to manage the inherent intermittency of renewable power generation across the short, medium and long term. As an energy trader, we buy and sell electricity and gas which is physically delivered on the grids, and we leverage our physical market knowledge to trade financial commodities. As a provider of renewable energy management services, we take on the complexity of managing renewable power across different countries so that our customers can focus on their core mission of investment and growth. Trailstone offers an efficient, fully automated front-to-back renewable power management platform underpinned by our long-standing market experience, proprietary technology, data analytics and meteorology.
